29	
30	## Overview
31	
32	Input components are the building blocks of data entry in ars-ui. They span boolean selection
33	(Checkbox, Radio, Switch), text entry (TextField, Textarea, SearchInput), numeric entry
34	(NumberInput), multi-cell PIN entry (PinInput), and range selection (Slider, RangeSlider).
35	
36	All input components share these traits:
37	
38	- **Form participation**: Each renders a hidden `<input>` so its value joins native form
39	  submission.
40	- **Controlled/uncontrolled duality**: Every value uses `Bindable<T>` so both modes work
41	  identically.
42	- **Label association**: Every component exposes a `Label` part; the connect API wires the
43	  `for`/`id` relationship automatically.
44	- **`aria-errormessage` wiring**: When `invalid === true`, components set both
45	  `aria-describedby` (description + error ID) and `aria-errormessage` (error ID only).
46	  `aria-errormessage` provides a direct machine-readable link to the error, while
47	  `aria-describedby` includes both the description and the error for a complete announcement.
48	  The `aria-errormessage` attribute MUST be omitted when the component is not invalid
49	  (pointing to a hidden error element is a WCAG violation).
50	- **Error and description linkage**: `aria-describedby` is built from `Description` and
51	  `ErrorMessage` anatomy parts. The standard wiring pattern for the primary interactive
52	  element's attrs method is:
53	
54	    ```rust,no_check
55	    // Build aria-describedby from description + error message parts.
56	    // IMPORTANT: Only reference IDs for parts that are actually rendered,
57	    // otherwise the aria-describedby will point to a non-existent element
58	    // (a "dangling reference"), which confuses assistive technology.
59	    let mut describedby_parts = Vec::new();
60	    if self.ctx.has_description {
61	        describedby_parts.push(self.ctx.ids.part("description"));
62	    }
63	    if self.ctx.invalid && self.ctx.has_error_message {
64	        describedby_parts.push(self.ctx.ids.part("error-message"));
65	    }
66	    if !describedby_parts.is_empty() {
67	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy), describedby_parts.join(" "));
68	    }
69	    ```
70	
71	    **Dangling reference prevention**: The error ID MUST only be appended to `aria-describedby`
72	    when the component is in an invalid state AND the error message element is actually rendered
73	    in the DOM (i.e., `invalid && has_error_message`). If the error message element is not
74	    rendered, including its ID creates a dangling ARIA reference to a non-existent element, which
75	    confuses assistive technology. The same guard applies to `aria-errormessage`.
76	
77	    **Multiple IDs order in `aria-describedby`**: When multiple IDs are present in
78	    `aria-describedby`, the order MUST be: description ID first, then error ID. Example:
79	    `aria-describedby="field-desc field-error"`. Screen readers announce referenced elements in
80	    the order the IDs are listed, so placing the description before the error ensures the user
81	    hears contextual help before the error message.
82	
83	- **Error announcement strategy**: Error messages are announced to assistive technology
84	  through a two-part mechanism:
85	    1. **`aria-describedby`**: The primary interactive element's `aria-describedby` points to
86	       the error-message part ID (when invalid). Screen readers announce this on focus.
87	    2. **`aria-live="polite"` region** (optional): For real-time validation (e.g., as-you-type),
88	       the error-message part may include `aria-live="polite"` so changes are announced without
89	       requiring focus movement. Components using `role="alert"` (which implies
90	       `aria-live="assertive"`) should NOT also set `aria-live` explicitly to avoid
91	       double-announcement.
92	    3. **Multi-field form batching**: When validating multiple fields simultaneously (e.g., on
93	       form submit), adapters SHOULD debounce error announcements to avoid overwhelming screen
94	       reader users. A recommended pattern is to announce a summary (e.g., "3 errors found")
95	       via a single live region, then let individual field errors be discovered via
96	       `aria-describedby` on focus.
97	- **Disabled and readonly propagation**: Both states flow to ARIA attributes and native HTML.
98	- **Focus visibility**: Keyboard-initiated focus emits `data-ars-focus-visible`; pointer does
99	  not.
100	
101	- **`on_focus_change` callback**: All input components accept an optional
102	  `on_focus_change: Option<Callback<bool>>` prop as a convenience over separate Focus/Blur
103	  event handling. The callback fires with `true` on Focus and `false` on Blur. This is a
104	  convenience shorthand — consumers who need richer focus information (e.g., `is_keyboard`)
105	  should handle the individual `Focus` and `Blur` events directly. Adapters fire
106	  `on_focus_change` in the same microtask as the underlying focus/blur transition.
107	
108	### Disabled State Coordination
109	
110	Components may be disabled by multiple independent sources: a direct `disabled` prop, a
111	`DisabledContext` provided by a parent (e.g., a `FieldSet` or `Form`), or per-item flags
112	(e.g., per-thumb disabled in RangeSlider). The effective disabled state is the logical OR
113	of all sources — if **any** source is `true`, the component is disabled.
114	
115	| Component     | `disabled` prop | `DisabledContext` | Per-item disabled | Guard logic                                                                |
116	| ------------- | :-------------: | :---------------: | :---------------: | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
117	| Checkbox      |       Yes       |        Yes        |        No         | `ctx.disabled \|\| disabled_context`                                       |
118	| CheckboxGroup |       Yes       |        Yes        |        No         | `ctx.disabled \|\| disabled_context`; propagates to children via ChildCtx  |
119	| RadioGroup    |       Yes       |        Yes        |  Per-radio item   | Group: `ctx.disabled \|\| disabled_context`; Item: also `item.disabled`    |
120	| Switch        |       Yes       |        Yes        |        No         | `ctx.disabled \|\| disabled_context`                                       |
121	| TextField     |       Yes       |        Yes        |        No         | `ctx.disabled \|\| disabled_context`                                       |
122	| Textarea      |       Yes       |        Yes        |        No         | `ctx.disabled \|\| disabled_context`                                       |
123	| PasswordInput |       Yes       |        Yes        |        No         | `ctx.disabled \|\| disabled_context`                                       |
124	| NumberInput   |       Yes       |        Yes        |        No         | `ctx.disabled \|\| disabled_context`                                       |
125	| PinInput      |       Yes       |        Yes        |        No         | `ctx.disabled \|\| disabled_context`                                       |
126	| Slider        |       Yes       |        Yes        |        No         | `ctx.disabled \|\| disabled_context`                                       |
127	| RangeSlider   |       Yes       |        Yes        |     Per-thumb     | `ctx.disabled \|\| disabled_context`; Per-thumb: also `start/end_disabled` |
128	| SearchInput   |       Yes       |        Yes        |        No         | `ctx.disabled \|\| disabled_context`                                       |
129	| Editable      |       Yes       |        Yes        |        No         | `ctx.disabled \|\| disabled_context`                                       |
130	| FileTrigger   |       Yes       |        No         |        No         | `props.disabled` (stateless — no context)                                  |
131	
132	Every transition guard that checks `ctx.disabled` MUST evaluate the effective disabled
133	state: `ctx.disabled || self.disabled_context()`. Adapters resolve `DisabledContext` during
134	`connect` and merge it into the guard check. This prevents a scenario where the prop is
135	`false` but the context is `true`, yet events are still processed.
136	
137	> **Important**: `placeholder` is NOT a substitute for a label. All inputs MUST have an
138	> associated `<label>` element, `aria-label`, or `aria-labelledby`. Placeholder text
139	> disappears on input and is not reliably announced by screen readers.
140	
141	### Label Visibility (WCAG 2.5.3 Label in Name)
142	
143	All input components must have a visible label whose text is included in the accessible name.
144	Using `aria-label` alone without a visible label fails WCAG 2.5.3. Recommended patterns:
145	
146	1. **Visible `<label>` element** with `for` attribute (preferred).
147	2. **`aria-labelledby`** pointing to a visible element.
148	3. **If a visible label is truly impossible** (e.g., icon-only search field), provide `aria-label`
149	   AND `title` attribute with matching text.
150	
151	### IME Composition Protocol
152	
153	All text-input components (`TextField`, `Textarea`, `NumberInput`, `SearchInput`, `ComboBox`, `DateField`,
154	`TimeField`) must implement the IME composition protocol:
155	
156	1. Track `is_composing: bool` in machine context — set `true` on `compositionstart`, `false`
157	   on `compositionend`.
158	2. During composition, suppress: typeahead search, value validation, auto-formatting, and
159	   change callbacks.
160	3. On `compositionend`, apply the final composed value and resume normal processing.
161	4. Adapters register `compositionstart`, `compositionupdate`, and `compositionend` event
162	   listeners on all text inputs.
163	
164	| Component       | Value Type        | Machine States                      | Key ARIA Pattern                     |
165	| --------------- | ----------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
166	| `Checkbox`      | `checkbox::State` | Unchecked / Checked / Indeterminate | `role="checkbox"`, `aria-checked`    |
167	| `CheckboxGroup` | `BTreeSet<Key>`   | Idle                                | `role="group"`, child propagation    |
168	| `RadioGroup`    | `Option<String>`  | Idle / Focused                      | `role="radiogroup"`, roving tabindex |
169	| `Switch`        | `bool`            | Off / On                            | `role="switch"`, `aria-checked`      |
170	| `TextField`     | `String`          | Idle / Focused                      | `role` implicit, `aria-invalid`      |
171	| `Textarea`      | `String`          | Idle / Focused                      | `role` implicit, `aria-invalid`      |
172	| `PasswordInput` | `String`          | Masked / Visible                    | `type="password"/"text"`, toggle     |
173	| `NumberInput`   | `Option<f64>`     | Idle / Focused / Scrubbing          | `role="spinbutton"`                  |
174	| `PinInput`      | `Vec<String>`     | Idle / Focused / Completed          | per-cell `aria-label`                |
175	| `Slider`        | `f64`             | Idle / Focused / Dragging           | `role="slider"`                      |
176	| `RangeSlider`   | `[f64; 2]`        | Idle / Focused / Dragging           | dual `role="slider"`                 |
177	| `SearchInput`   | `String`          | Idle / Focused / Searching          | `role="search"`                      |
178	| `Editable`      | `String`          | Preview / Editing                   | `role="group"`, inline edit          |
179	| `FileTrigger`   | (Platform files)  | (Stateless)                         | hidden `<input type="file">`         |
180	
181	---
182	
183	## Appendix A: Shared Data Attributes
184	
185	All input components emit these data attributes on their Root part:
186	
187	| Attribute                | Condition                      |
188	| ------------------------ | ------------------------------ |
189	| `data-ars-disabled`      | Component is disabled          |
190	| `data-ars-readonly`      | Component is readonly          |
191	| `data-ars-invalid`       | Component has validation error |
192	| `data-ars-required`      | Component is required          |
193	| `data-ars-focus-visible` | Keyboard focus is active       |
194	| `data-ars-state`         | Component-specific state token |
195	
196	## Appendix B: Shared Conventions
197	
198	### `Bindable<T>` Pattern
199	
200	Every input value uses `Bindable<T>` (defined in `01-architecture.md`):
201	
202	```rust,no_check
203	// Uncontrolled: consumer provides default_value, machine owns state
204	let checkbox = Props { default_checked: checkbox::State::Checked, ..Default::default() };
205	
206	// Controlled: consumer provides value, adapter handles change callbacks
207	let checkbox = Props {
208	    checked: Some(checkbox::State::Checked),
209	    ..Default::default()
210	};
211	```
212	
213	### `AttrMap` Spreading
214	
215	The connect API returns `AttrMap` values that framework adapters spread onto DOM elements:
216	
217	```rust,no_check
218	// Leptos example
219	let api = Machine::connect(&state, &ctx, &props, &send);
220	view! {
221	    <div {..api.root_attrs()}>
222	        <label {..api.label_attrs()}>"Accept terms"</label>
223	        <div {..api.control_attrs()}>
224	            <div {..api.indicator_attrs()} />
225	        </div>
226	    </div>
227	}
228	```
229	
230	### Focus Visibility
231	
232	All input components track `focus_visible` independently from `focused`:
233	
234	- `focused`: Set on any `Focus` event.
235	- `focus_visible`: Set only when `Focus { is_keyboard: true }`.
236	- `data-ars-focus-visible` attribute only appears when `focus_visible=true`.
237	- CSS can use `[data-ars-focus-visible]:focus { outline: 2px solid blue; }` for keyboard-only
238	  focus rings.
239	
240	### Form Participation
241	
242	Every input component renders a hidden `<input>` (or `<input type="hidden">`) for native
243	form submission.
244	
245	> **Shadow DOM constraint:** The hidden input MUST be in the same DOM context as the
246	> `<form>` element. If a component uses Shadow DOM, the hidden input must be rendered
247	> in the light DOM (e.g., via a `<slot>`) or use an explicit `form` attribute pointing
248	> to the form's `id` so the input participates in form submission across shadow
249	> boundaries. Adapters using Shadow DOM MUST implement one of these strategies.
250	
251	Per-component hidden input patterns:
252	
253	- `Checkbox`: `<input type="checkbox" name="..." value="..." checked>`
254	- `CheckboxGroup`: `<input type="checkbox" name="..." value="..." checked>` per checked value
255	- `RadioGroup`: `<input type="radio" name="..." value="..." checked>` per item
256	- `Switch`: `<input type="checkbox" name="..." value="..." checked>`
257	- `TextField`: value is on the visible `<input>` itself
258	- `Textarea`: value is on the visible `<textarea>` itself
259	- `PasswordInput`: value is on the visible `<input>` itself
260	- `NumberInput`: value is on the visible `<input>` itself (role="spinbutton")
261	- `PinInput`: `<input type="hidden" name="..." value="...">` (combined string)
262	- `Slider`: `<input type="hidden" name="..." value="...">`
263	- `RangeSlider`: `<input type="hidden" name="...[0]" value="...">` + `name="...[1]"` (two inputs)
264	- `SearchInput`: value is on the visible `<input type="search">` itself
265	- `Editable`: no hidden input by default (consumer wraps if needed)
266	- `FileTrigger`: `<input type="file">` (visually hidden, native file submission)
267	
```

721	// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
722	// Machine trait
723	// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
724	
725	/// Defines a component as a finite state machine.
726	///
727	/// A `Machine` declares the component's state type, event type, internal context,
728	/// props, and connect API. It provides pure functions for initialization, transition
729	/// logic, and DOM attribute generation — with no framework dependency.
730	pub trait Machine: Sized + 'static {
731	    /// The state type representing the machine's current configuration.
732	    type State: Clone + Debug + PartialEq;
733	
734	    /// The event type that triggers state transitions.
735	    type Event: Clone + Debug;
736	
737	    /// Internal context accumulated across transitions (e.g. focused index, scroll offset).
738	    type Context: Clone + Debug;
739	
740	    /// External configuration passed in by the parent component.
741	    type Props: Clone + PartialEq + HasId;
742	
743	    /// Per-component i18n messages type.
744	    type Messages: ComponentMessages + Clone + Default + 'static;
745	
746	    /// Typed identifier for the named effect intents this machine emits.
747	    ///
748	    /// Each component declares its own enum (e.g. `popover::Effect`,
749	    /// `dialog::Effect`) — every variant is a stable identifier the
750	    /// compiler treats as the single source of truth. Adapters that
751	    /// route on names use exhaustive `match effect.name { … }` so a new
752	    /// variant added in the component forces every adapter to update.
753	    ///
754	    /// Machines that never emit named effects use [`NoEffect`]; the
755	    /// uninhabited type makes `PendingEffect::<_>::named(...)`
756	    /// uncallable for that machine.
757	    ///
758	    /// Prototypes and internal test fixtures can use
759	    /// `type Effect = &'static str` — `&'static str` already implements
760	    /// [`EffectName`] — but production machines should prefer a
761	    /// bespoke enum so authoring code, adapter dispatch, and test
762	    /// fixtures share one typed identifier. See [`EffectName`] for the
763	    /// full bound rationale.
764	    type Effect: EffectName;
765	
766	    /// The connect API type that produces attributes from current state.
767	    type Api<'a>: ConnectApi
768	    where
769	        Self: 'a;
770	
771	    /// Initialize the machine from props and adapter-resolved environment values,
772	    /// returning initial state and context.
773	    ///
774	    /// The adapter resolves `env` (locale, ICU provider) and `messages` from
775	    /// `ArsProvider` context before calling this method. Core code never calls
776	    /// framework hooks — all environment values arrive as parameters.
777	    fn init(
778	        props: &Self::Props,
779	        env: &Env,
780	        messages: &Self::Messages,
781	    ) -> (Self::State, Self::Context);
782	
783	    /// Evaluates an event against the current state, context, and props.
784	    ///
785	    /// Returns `Some(plan)` to apply a transition or `None` to ignore the event.
786	    fn transition(
787	        state: &Self::State,
788	        event: &Self::Event,
789	        context: &Self::Context,
790	        props: &Self::Props,
791	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>>;
792	
793	    /// Creates the connect API for producing DOM attributes from the current state.
794	    fn connect<'a>(
795	        state: &'a Self::State,
796	        context: &'a Self::Context,
797	        props: &'a Self::Props,
798	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
799	    ) -> Self::Api<'a>;
800	
801	    /// Synchronizes prop changes by emitting events.
802	    ///
803	    /// Called by [`Service::set_props`] when props change. Returns events
804	    /// that are enqueued for processing (e.g., `SetValue`, `SetMode`).

472	/// Trait alias-style marker for values usable with [`Bindable`].
473	///
474	/// All bindable values must support cloning for state updates, equality for
475	/// change detection, and debug output for diagnostics.
476	pub trait BindableValue: Clone + PartialEq + Debug {}
477	
478	impl<T: Clone + PartialEq + Debug> BindableValue for T {}
479	
480	/// A value that may be controlled by the parent or managed internally.
481	///
482	/// Components that support two-way binding use `Bindable` to distinguish between
483	/// values owned by the parent ([`controlled`](Bindable::controlled)) and values
484	/// managed by the component itself ([`uncontrolled`](Bindable::uncontrolled)).
485	///
486	/// When controlled, [`set`](Bindable::set) updates the internal copy but
487	/// [`get`](Bindable::get) always returns the controlled value. The parent
488	/// must call [`sync_controlled`](Bindable::sync_controlled) to push new
489	/// controlled values.
490	#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
491	pub struct Bindable<T: BindableValue> {
492	    /// The externally controlled value, or `None` if uncontrolled.
493	    controlled: Option<T>,
494	
495	    /// The internal value managed by the component.
496	    internal: T,
497	}
498	
499	impl<T: BindableValue> Bindable<T> {
500	    /// Creates a controlled bindable owned by the parent.
501	    ///
502	    /// Both the controlled and internal fields are initialized to the given value.
503	    /// The component reads the controlled value via [`get`](Self::get).
504	    #[must_use]
505	    pub fn controlled(value: T) -> Self {
506	        Self {
507	            internal: value.clone(),
508	            controlled: Some(value),
509	        }
510	    }
511	
512	    /// Creates an uncontrolled bindable managed by the component.
513	    ///
514	    /// There is no external controlled value; [`get`](Self::get) returns the
515	    /// internal value which can be updated via [`set`](Self::set).
516	    #[must_use]
517	    pub const fn uncontrolled(default: T) -> Self {
518	        Self {
519	            controlled: None,
520	            internal: default,
521	        }
522	    }
523	
524	    /// Returns a reference to the current value.
525	    ///
526	    /// Returns the controlled value if set, otherwise the internal value.
527	    #[must_use]
528	    pub fn get(&self) -> &T {
529	        self.controlled.as_ref().unwrap_or(&self.internal)
530	    }
531	
532	    /// Returns `true` if this value is controlled by the parent.
533	    #[must_use]
534	    pub const fn is_controlled(&self) -> bool {
535	        self.controlled.is_some()
536	    }
537	
538	    /// Updates the internal value.
539	    ///
540	    /// In controlled mode, this becomes the pending internal value that is
541	    /// revealed once the bindable returns to uncontrolled mode.
542	    pub fn set(&mut self, value: T) {
543	        self.internal = value;
544	    }
545	
546	    /// Pushes a new controlled value from the parent.
547	    ///
548	    /// This should be called when the parent's controlled prop changes.
549	    pub fn sync_controlled(&mut self, value: Option<T>) {
550	        self.controlled = value;
551	    }
552	
553	    /// Returns a mutable reference to the internal value.
554	    ///
555	    /// Use for in-place mutations on collection types to avoid cloning.
556	    /// **Warning:** For controlled bindables, mutating the internal value has no
557	    /// effect on what [`get`](Self::get) returns (it returns the controlled value).
558	    pub const fn get_mut_owned(&mut self) -> &mut T {
559	        &mut self.internal
560	    }
561	}
562	
563	impl<T: BindableValue + Default> Default for Bindable<T> {
564	    fn default() -> Self {
565	        Self::uncontrolled(T::default())
566	    }
567	}

146	    /// Accessible label for the clear button. Default: `"Clear search"`.
147	    pub clear_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
148	    /// Accessible label for the submit button. Default: `"Submit search"`.
149	    pub submit_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
150	}
151

162	```
163	
164	> **Callback props (`on_submit`, `on_clear`)**: These are provided by the adapter layer, not the core state machine. The adapter MUST wire: `on_submit` fires when `Event::Submit` is processed (Enter key or SubmitTrigger click), receiving the current `ctx.value`; `on_clear` fires when `Event::Clear` is processed (ClearTrigger click or Escape key).
165	
166	### 1.5 Debounce Timer Integration
167	
168	The debounce timer is a `PendingEffect` managed by the state machine, not a simple adapter-side `setTimeout`. This ensures the timer lifecycle is tied to the machine's effect system and properly cleaned up on unmount or state changes.
169	
170	- **On `Event::Change`**: The machine cancels any existing debounce timer effect and starts a new one with the configured `debounce_ms` duration.
171	- **On timer expiration**: The effect fires `Event::DebounceExpired`, which triggers the `on_change` callback with the current `ctx.value`.
172	- **Rapid inputs**: Each new `Event::Change` resets the timer, ensuring only the final value after the user stops typing triggers the callback.
173	- **`Event::Submit`**: Cancels any pending debounce timer and fires the callback immediately (explicit submit should not be delayed).
174	- **`Event::Clear`**: Cancels any pending debounce timer and fires the callback immediately with an empty string.
175	
176	**Props change (`debounce_ms` mutation)**: When the `debounce_ms` prop changes while a debounce timer is active, the machine cancels the active timer and starts a fresh one with the new duration. A `debounce_ms` value of `Some(0)` is treated as `Some(1)` to prevent microtask-level race conditions.
177	
178	### 1.6 Full Machine Implementation
179	
180	```rust
181	/// The machine for the SearchInput component.
182	pub struct Machine;
183	
184	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
185	    type State = State;
186	    type Event = Event;
187	    type Context = Context;
188	    type Props = Props;
189	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
190	    type Messages = Messages;
191	
192	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
193	        let locale = env.locale.clone();
194	        let messages = messages.clone();
195	        let state = State::Idle;
196	        let ctx = Context {
197	            value: match &props.value {
198	                Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v.clone()),
199	                None => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value.clone()),
200	            },
201	            disabled: props.disabled,
202	            readonly: props.readonly,
203	            invalid: props.invalid,
204	            focused: false,
205	            focus_visible: false,
206	            loading: false,
207	            name: props.name.clone(),
208	            placeholder: props.placeholder.clone(),
209	            is_composing: false,
210	            has_description: false,
211	            locale,
212	            messages,
213	            ids: ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id),
214	        };
215	        (state, ctx)
216	    }
217	
218	    fn transition(
219	        state: &Self::State,
220	        event: &Self::Event,
221	        ctx: &Self::Context,
222	        _props: &Self::Props,
223	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
224	        match event {
225	            Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {
226	                let is_kb = *is_keyboard;
227	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
228	                    ctx.focused = true;
229	                    ctx.focus_visible = is_kb;
230	                }))
231	            }
232	            Event::Blur => {
233	                let is_loading = ctx.loading;
234	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(if is_loading { State::Searching } else { State::Idle })
235	                    .apply(|ctx| {
236	                        ctx.focused = false;
237	                        ctx.focus_visible = false;
238	                    }))
239	            }
240	            Event::Change(val) => {
241	                if ctx.disabled || ctx.readonly { return None; }
242	                let val = val.clone();
243	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
244	                    ctx.value.set(val);
245	                }))
246	            }
247	            Event::Clear => {
248	                if ctx.disabled || ctx.readonly { return None; }
249	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
250	                    ctx.value.set(String::new());
251	                }))
252	            }
253	            Event::Submit => {
254	                if ctx.disabled { return None; }
255	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Searching).apply(|ctx| {
256	                    ctx.loading = true;
257	                }))
258	            }
259	            Event::SetSearching(loading) => {
260	                let loading = *loading;
261	                let is_focused = ctx.focused;
262	                if !loading {
263	                    Some(TransitionPlan::to(if is_focused { State::Focused } else { State::Idle })
264	                        .apply(move |ctx| { ctx.loading = loading; }))
265	                } else {
266	                    Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Searching)
267	                        .apply(move |ctx| { ctx.loading = loading; }))
268	                }
269	            }
270	            Event::CompositionStart => {
271	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| { ctx.is_composing = true; }))
272	            }
273	            Event::CompositionEnd => {
274	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| { ctx.is_composing = false; }))
275	            }
276	            Event::DebounceExpired | Event::CancelDebounce => {
277	                // Handled by the effect system; no state/context change
278	                None
279	            }
280	        }
281	    }
282	
283	    fn connect<'a>(
284	        state: &'a Self::State,
285	        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
286	        props: &'a Self::Props,
287	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
288	    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
289	        Api { state, ctx, props, send }
290	    }
291	}
292	```

462	## 2. Anatomy
463	
464	```text
465	SearchInput
466	├── Root               <div>     data-ars-scope="search-input" data-ars-part="root" (role="search")
467	├── Label              <label>   data-ars-part="label"
468	├── Input         [A]  <input>   data-ars-part="input" (type="search")
469	├── ClearTrigger       <button>  data-ars-part="clear-trigger" (hidden when empty)
470	├── SubmitTrigger      <button>  data-ars-part="submit-trigger" (optional)
471	├── LoadingIndicator   <div>     data-ars-part="loading-indicator" (shown when searching)
472	├── Description        <div>     data-ars-part="description" (optional)
473	└── ErrorMessage       <div>     data-ars-part="error-message" (optional)
474	```
475	
476	| Part             | Element    | Key Attributes                                              |
477	| ---------------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
478	| Root             | `<div>`    | `role="search"`, `data-ars-state`, `aria-busy` when loading |
479	| Label            | `<label>`  | `for` points to Input                                       |
480	| Input            | `<input>`  | `type="search"`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`      |
481	| ClearTrigger     | `<button>` | `aria-label`, hidden via `display:none` when value is empty |
482	| SubmitTrigger    | `<button>` | `aria-label` (optional)                                     |
483	| LoadingIndicator | `<div>`    | `aria-hidden="true"` — shown during Searching state         |
484	| Description      | `<div>`    | Help text; linked via `aria-describedby` (optional)         |
485	| ErrorMessage     | `<div>`    | Validation error; linked via `aria-describedby` (optional)  |
486	
487	## 3. Accessibility
488	
489	### 3.1 ARIA Roles, States, and Properties
490	
491	| Property           | Element       | Value                                      |
492	| ------------------ | ------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
493	| `role`             | Root          | `search` (landmark)                        |
494	| `type`             | Input         | `"search"`                                 |
495	| `aria-busy`        | Root          | Present when `loading=true`                |
496	| `aria-invalid`     | Input         | Present when `invalid=true`                |
497	| `required`         | Input         | Present when `required=true` (native attr) |
498	| `aria-labelledby`  | Input         | Points to Label id                         |
499	| `aria-describedby` | Input         | Points to Description + ErrorMessage       |
500	| `aria-label`       | ClearTrigger  | From `messages.clear_label`                |
501	| `aria-label`       | SubmitTrigger | From `messages.submit_label`               |
502	
503	### 3.2 Keyboard Interaction
504	
505	| Key    | Action                              |
506	| ------ | ----------------------------------- |
507	| Enter  | Submit search query                 |
508	| Escape | Clear input                         |
509	| Tab    | Navigate between input and triggers |
510	
511	### 3.3 Keyboard Event Propagation in Nested Components
512	
513	When `SearchInput` is nested inside a parent component that also handles keyboard events (e.g., `Combobox`), event propagation must be carefully managed:
514	
515	**Rule**: `SearchInput` calls `stopPropagation()` **only** for keys it actually handles (Enter, Escape). It MUST NOT call `stopPropagation()` for keys it does not handle (ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End, etc.), allowing the parent component to process them.
516	
517	**IME composition during nesting**: SearchInput emits `on_change` during active IME composition with the `is_composing: true` flag set in context. Parent components (e.g., Combobox) MUST check `search_input_ctx.is_composing` before filtering — when `true`, skip filtering to avoid showing results for incomplete CJK input.
518	
519	### 3.4 Browser SearchBox Integration
520	
521	When used with dropdown-style results (e.g., paired with a Listbox for suggestions), the following ARIA attributes are mandatory on the Input part:
522	
523	- `aria-controls`: Points to the results container element ID.
524	- `aria-expanded`: `"true"` when the results dropdown is visible, `"false"` otherwise.
525	- `autocomplete="off"`: Prevents browser autofill from interfering with custom results.
526	- `role="combobox"`: When paired with a results dropdown, overrides the implicit role.
527	
528	When SearchInput is used standalone (no dropdown), these attributes are not required.
529	
530	### 3.5 Autocomplete Results Announcement
531	
532	When paired with a results dropdown, the adapter MUST announce result counts to screen reader users via a live region, debounced by at least 300ms:
533	
534	- `"{N} results available"` when results arrive.
535	- `"No results available"` when the query returns no matches.
536	- The live region uses `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-atomic="true"`.
537	
538	## 4. Internationalization
539	
540	- `placeholder` localized by consumer ("Search...", "Rechercher...", etc.).
541	- `aria-label` for `ClearTrigger` and `SubmitTrigger` localized via `Messages`.
542	- RTL: Input text direction follows locale; icon positions may swap (CSS handles this).
543	
544	### 4.1 IME Composition Handling
545	
546	`SearchInput` tracks `is_composing: bool` in Context. During composition:
547	
548	- `Event::Change` still updates `ctx.value` for display, but the `on_change` callback and debounce timer are NOT triggered.
549	- After `compositionend`, the adapter fires a final `Event::Change` with the committed text, which triggers normal filter/debounce processing.
550	
551	See [IME Composition Protocol](./_category.md#ime-composition-protocol).
552	
553	### 4.2 Clear Event and Debounce Interaction
554	
555	When the user triggers the clear action:
556	
557	1. Any pending debounce timer is immediately cancelled.
558	2. `on_change("")` is emitted synchronously — bypasses debounce delay entirely.
559	3. A `debounce_ms` value of `Some(0)` is treated as `Some(1)` to prevent microtask-level race conditions.
560	
561	## 5. Form Integration
562	
563	- **Hidden input**: The `Input` part is the native `<input type="search">` and participates directly in form submission via its `name` attribute.
564	- **Validation states**: `aria-invalid="true"` on the Input when `invalid=true`. Native `required` attribute on Input when `required=true`. The `ErrorMessage` part is linked via `aria-describedby`.
565	- **Error message association**: `aria-describedby` on Input points to `Description` (when present) and `ErrorMessage` (when invalid).
566	- **Reset behavior**: On form reset, the adapter restores `value` to `default_value` and transitions to Idle.
567	- **Disabled/readonly propagation**: When inside a `Field` or `Fieldset`, the adapter merges `disabled`/`readonly` from `FieldCtx` per `07-forms.md` §12.6.
568	
569	## 6. Library Parity
570	
571	> Compared against: React Aria (`SearchField`).
572	>
573	> Note: Ark UI and Radix UI have no dedicated search input component.
574	
575	### 6.1 Props
576	
577	| Feature          | ars-ui                        | React Aria     | Notes              |
578	| ---------------- | ----------------------------- | -------------- | ------------------ |
579	| Controlled value | `value: Option<String>`       | `value`        | Full parity        |
580	| Default value    | `default_value: String`       | `defaultValue` | Full parity        |
581	| Disabled         | `disabled: bool`              | `isDisabled`   | Full parity        |
582	| Read-only        | `readonly: bool`              | `isReadOnly`   | Full parity        |
583	| Required         | `required: bool`              | `isRequired`   | Full parity        |
584	| Invalid          | `invalid: bool`               | `isInvalid`    | Full parity        |
585	| Placeholder      | `placeholder: Option<String>` | `placeholder`  | Full parity        |
586	| Form name        | `name: Option<String>`        | `name`         | Full parity        |
587	| Form ID          | `form: Option<String>`        | `form`         | Full parity        |
588	| Debounce         | `debounce_ms: Option<u32>`    | --             | ars-ui enhancement |
589	
590	**Gaps:** None.
591	
592	### 6.2 Anatomy
593	
594	| Part             | ars-ui             | React Aria          | Notes              |
595	| ---------------- | ------------------ | ------------------- | ------------------ |
596	| Root             | `Root`             | `SearchField`       | Full parity        |
597	| Label            | `Label`            | `Label`             | Full parity        |
598	| Input            | `Input`            | `Input`             | Full parity        |
599	| ClearTrigger     | `ClearTrigger`     | `Button` (clear)    | Full parity        |
600	| SubmitTrigger    | `SubmitTrigger`    | --                  | ars-ui enhancement |
601	| LoadingIndicator | `LoadingIndicator` | --                  | ars-ui enhancement |
602	| Description      | `Description`      | `Text[description]` | Full parity        |
603	| ErrorMessage     | `ErrorMessage`     | `FieldError`        | Full parity        |
604	
605	**Gaps:** None.
606	
607	### 6.3 Events
608	
609	| Callback      | ars-ui           | React Aria         | Notes       |
610	| ------------- | ---------------- | ------------------ | ----------- |
611	| Value changed | `Change(String)` | `onChange`         | Full parity |
612	| Submit        | `Submit`         | `onSubmit`         | Full parity |
613	| Clear         | `Clear`          | `onClear`          | Full parity |
614	| Focus         | `Focus`/`Blur`   | `onFocus`/`onBlur` | Full parity |
615	
616	**Gaps:** None.
617	
618	### 6.4 Features
619	
620	| Feature         | ars-ui | React Aria |
621	| --------------- | ------ | ---------- |
622	| Clear on Escape | Yes    | Yes        |
623	| Submit on Enter | Yes    | Yes        |
624	| Loading state   | Yes    | --         |
625	| Debounce        | Yes    | --         |
626	| IME composition | Yes    | Yes        |
627	| `type="search"` | Yes    | Yes        |
628	
629	**Gaps:** None.
630	
631	### 6.5 Summary
632	
633	- **Overall:** Full parity with React Aria SearchField.
634	- **Divergences:** ars-ui adds a loading/searching state, debounce support, submit trigger, and loading indicator not present in React Aria.
635	- **Recommended additions:** None.

220	### 1.5 Rounding Mode Specification
221	
222	All floating-point rounding in NumberInput and Slider MUST use **round-half-up** (standard arithmetic rounding) as the rounding mode. This is the `RoundingMode::HalfUp` equivalent: if the digit being dropped is exactly 5, round away from zero.
223	
224	**Rationale**: Banker's rounding (`round-half-even`) is used in financial accounting to minimize cumulative bias, but it produces counterintuitive results for end users (e.g., `2.5` rounds to `2`, not `3`). Interactive UI components prioritize user expectation over statistical properties.
225	
226	```rust
227	/// Round `value` to `precision` decimal places using round-half-up.
228	fn round_to_precision(value: f64, precision: Option<u32>) -> f64 {
229	    match precision {
230	        Some(p) => {
231	            let factor = 10_f64.powi(p as i32);
232	            (value * factor + 0.5_f64.copysign(value)).trunc() / factor
233	        }
234	        None => value,
235	    }
236	}
237	```
238	
239	| Input   | Precision | Result | Explanation                |
240	| ------- | --------- | ------ | -------------------------- |
241	| `2.5`   | 0         | `3`    | Half rounds up             |
242	| `-2.5`  | 0         | `-3`   | Half rounds away from zero |
243	| `0.105` | 2         | `0.11` | Half-up at 3rd decimal     |
244	| `0.115` | 2         | `0.12` | Half-up at 3rd decimal     |
245	| `1.005` | 2         | `1.01` | Half-up at 3rd decimal     |
246	
247	**Application Order**: Precision rounding is applied AFTER clamping to min/max but BEFORE storing in Context.
248	
249	### 1.6 Full Machine Implementation
250	
251	```rust
252	/// The machine for the NumberInput component.
253	pub struct Machine;
254	
255	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
256	    type State = State;
257	    type Event = Event;
258	    type Context = Context;
259	    type Props = Props;
260	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
261	    type Messages = Messages;
262	
263	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
264	        let locale = env.locale.clone();
265	        let messages = messages.clone();
266	        let state = State::Idle;
267	        let ctx = Context {
268	            value: match props.value {
269	                Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(Some(v)),
270	                None => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value),
271	            },
272	            min: props.min,
273	            max: props.max,
274	            step: props.step,
275	            large_step: props.large_step,
276	            precision: props.precision,
277	            disabled: props.disabled,
278	            readonly: props.readonly,
279	            invalid: props.invalid,
280	            required: props.required,
281	            focused: false,
282	            focus_visible: false,
283	            name: props.name.clone(),
284	            spin_on_press: props.spin_on_press,
285	            scrubbing: false,
286	            is_composing: false,
287	            has_description: false,
288	            locale,
289	            messages,
290	            ids: ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id),
291	        };
292	        (state, ctx)
293	    }
294	
295	    fn transition(
296	        state: &Self::State,
297	        event: &Self::Event,
298	        ctx: &Self::Context,
299	        props: &Self::Props,
300	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
301	        if ctx.disabled || ctx.readonly {
302	            match event {
303	                Event::Increment | Event::Decrement
304	                | Event::IncrementLarge | Event::DecrementLarge
305	                | Event::IncrementToMax | Event::DecrementToMin
306	                | Event::Change(_) | Event::SetValue(_)
307	                | Event::StartScrub | Event::Scrub(_) | Event::EndScrub
308	                | Event::Wheel { .. } => return None,
309	                _ => {}
310	            }
311	        }
312	
313	        match event {
314	            Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {
315	                let is_kb = *is_keyboard;
316	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
317	                    ctx.focused = true;
318	                    ctx.focus_visible = is_kb;
319	                }))
320	            }
321	            Event::Blur => {
322	                let clamp_min = ctx.min;
323	                let clamp_max = ctx.max;
324	                let current_val = *ctx.value.get();
325	                let clamp_on_blur = props.clamp_value_on_blur;
326	                let precision = ctx.precision;
327	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(move |ctx| {
328	                    ctx.focused = false;
329	                    ctx.focus_visible = false;
330	                    if clamp_on_blur {
331	                        if let Some(val) = current_val {
332	                            let clamped = val.clamp(clamp_min, clamp_max);
333	                            if clamped != val {
334	                                ctx.value.set(Some(round_to_precision(clamped, precision)));
335	                            }
336	                        }
337	                    }
338	                }))
339	            }
340	            Event::Increment => {
341	                let current = ctx.value.get().unwrap_or(ctx.min);
342	                let next = round_to_precision((current + ctx.step).min(ctx.max), ctx.precision);
343	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| { ctx.value.set(Some(next)); }))
344	            }
345	            Event::Decrement => {
346	                let current = ctx.value.get().unwrap_or(ctx.min);
347	                let prev = round_to_precision((current - ctx.step).max(ctx.min), ctx.precision);
348	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| { ctx.value.set(Some(prev)); }))
349	            }
350	            Event::IncrementLarge => {
351	                let current = ctx.value.get().unwrap_or(ctx.min);
352	                let next = round_to_precision((current + ctx.large_step).min(ctx.max), ctx.precision);
353	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| { ctx.value.set(Some(next)); }))
354	            }
355	            Event::DecrementLarge => {
356	                let current = ctx.value.get().unwrap_or(ctx.min);
357	                let prev = round_to_precision((current - ctx.large_step).max(ctx.min), ctx.precision);
358	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| { ctx.value.set(Some(prev)); }))
359	            }
360	            Event::IncrementToMax => {
361	                let max = ctx.max;
362	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| { ctx.value.set(Some(max)); }))
363	            }
364	            Event::DecrementToMin => {
365	                let min = ctx.min;
366	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| { ctx.value.set(Some(min)); }))
367	            }
368	            Event::SetValue(val) => {
369	                let rounded = round_to_precision(val.clamp(ctx.min, ctx.max), ctx.precision);
370	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| { ctx.value.set(Some(rounded)); }))
371	            }
372	            Event::Change(text) => {
373	                let text = text.clone();
374	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
375	                    if text.is_empty() {
376	                        ctx.value.set(None);
377	                    } else if let Ok(val) = text.parse::<f64>() {
378	                        ctx.value.set(Some(val));
379	                    }
380	                }))
381	            }
382	            Event::StartScrub => {
383	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Scrubbing).apply(|ctx| { ctx.scrubbing = true; }))
384	            }
385	            Event::Scrub(delta) if matches!(state, State::Scrubbing) => {
386	                let current = ctx.value.get().unwrap_or(0.0);
387	                let next = round_to_precision((current + delta * ctx.step).clamp(ctx.min, ctx.max), ctx.precision);
388	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| { ctx.value.set(Some(next)); }))
389	            }
390	            Event::EndScrub => {
391	                let is_focused = ctx.focused;
392	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(if is_focused { State::Focused } else { State::Idle })
393	                    .apply(|ctx| { ctx.scrubbing = false; }))
394	            }
395	            Event::Wheel { delta } if matches!(state, State::Focused) && !ctx.readonly && props.allow_mouse_wheel => {
396	                let event = if *delta > 0.0 { Event::Increment } else { Event::Decrement };
397	                Self::transition(state, &event, ctx, props)
398	            }
399	            Event::CompositionStart => {
400	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| { ctx.is_composing = true; }))
401	            }
402	            Event::CompositionEnd => {
403	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| { ctx.is_composing = false; }))
404	            }
405	            _ => None,
406	        }
407	    }
408	
409	    fn connect<'a>(
410	        state: &'a Self::State,
411	        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
412	        props: &'a Self::Props,
413	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
414	    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
415	        Api { state, ctx, props, send }
416	    }
417	}
418	```

420	### 1.7 Connect / API
421	
422	```rust
423	#[derive(ComponentPart)]
424	#[scope = "number-input"]
425	pub enum Part {
426	    Root,
427	    Label,
428	    Input,
429	    IncrementTrigger,
430	    DecrementTrigger,
431	    Description,
432	    ErrorMessage,
433	}
434	
435	/// The API for the NumberInput component.
436	pub struct Api<'a> {
437	    state: &'a State,
438	    ctx: &'a Context,
439	    props: &'a Props,
440	    send: &'a dyn Fn(Event),
441	}
442	
443	impl<'a> Api<'a> {
444	    /// Attributes for the root container.
445	    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
446	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
447	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();
448	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
449	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
450	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-state"), match self.state {
451	            State::Idle => "idle",
452	            State::Focused => "focused",
453	            State::Scrubbing => "scrubbing",
454	        });
455	        if self.ctx.disabled { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"), true); }
456	        if self.ctx.invalid { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-invalid"), true); }
457	        if self.ctx.readonly { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-readonly"), true); }
458	        if self.ctx.focus_visible { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focus-visible"), true); }
459	        attrs
460	    }
461	
462	    /// Attributes for the label element.
463	    pub fn label_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
464	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
465	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Label.data_attrs();
466	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
467	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
468	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("label"));
469	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::For, self.ctx.ids.part("input"));
470	        attrs
471	    }
472	
473	    /// Attributes for the native input element.
474	    pub fn input_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
475	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
476	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Input.data_attrs();
477	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
478	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
479	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("input"));
480	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "spinbutton");
481	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::InputMode, "decimal");
482	        if let Some(val) = self.ctx.value.get() {
483	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueNow), val.to_string());
484	        }
485	        if self.ctx.min.is_finite() {
486	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueMin), self.ctx.min.to_string());
487	        }
488	        if self.ctx.max.is_finite() {
489	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueMax), self.ctx.max.to_string());
490	        }
491	        // aria-valuetext should be set by the adapter using locale-formatted value
492	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::LabelledBy), self.ctx.ids.part("label"));
493	        if self.ctx.has_description {
494	            let mut describedby_parts = Vec::new();
495	            describedby_parts.push(self.ctx.ids.part("description"));
496	            if self.ctx.invalid {
497	                describedby_parts.push(self.ctx.ids.part("error-message"));
498	            }
499	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy), describedby_parts.join(" "));
500	        } else if self.ctx.invalid {
501	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy), self.ctx.ids.part("error-message"));
502	        }
503	        if self.ctx.required { attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Required), "true"); }
504	        if self.ctx.invalid { attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Invalid), "true"); }
505	        if self.ctx.disabled { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Disabled, true); }
506	        if self.ctx.readonly { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::ReadOnly, true); }
507	        if let Some(ref name) = self.ctx.name { attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Name, name); }
508	        if let Some(ref form) = self.props.form { attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Form, form); }
509	        attrs
510	    }
511	
512	    /// Attributes for the increment trigger button.
513	    /// **Spin-on-press behavior:** When `ctx.spin_on_press` is `true`, the adapter
514	    /// attaches `pointerdown` on increment/decrement triggers to start a repeating
515	    /// timer that sends `Event::Increment`/`Event::Decrement` with accelerating
516	    /// speed: initial delay 400ms, then 50ms intervals. The timer stops on
517	    /// `pointerup`/`pointerleave`. When `false`, each click sends a single event.
518	    pub fn increment_trigger_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
519	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
520	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::IncrementTrigger.data_attrs();
521	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
522	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
523	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Type, "button");
524	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label), (self.ctx.messages.increment_label)(&self.ctx.locale));
525	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, "-1");
526	        if self.ctx.disabled || self.ctx.readonly {
527	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Disabled, true);
528	        }
529	        // Disable at max boundary
530	        if let Some(val) = self.ctx.value.get() {
531	            if *val >= self.ctx.max { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Disabled, true); }
532	        }
533	        attrs
534	    }
535	
536	    /// Attributes for the decrement trigger button.
537	    pub fn decrement_trigger_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
538	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
539	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::DecrementTrigger.data_attrs();
540	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
541	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
542	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Type, "button");
543	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label), (self.ctx.messages.decrement_label)(&self.ctx.locale));
544	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, "-1");
545	        if self.ctx.disabled || self.ctx.readonly {
546	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Disabled, true);
547	        }
548	        // Disable at min boundary
549	        if let Some(val) = self.ctx.value.get() {
550	            if *val <= self.ctx.min { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Disabled, true); }
551	        }
552	        attrs
553	    }
554	
555	    /// Attributes for the description/help text element.
556	    pub fn description_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
557	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
558	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Description.data_attrs();
559	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
560	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
561	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("description"));
562	        attrs
563	    }
564	
565	    /// Attributes for the error message element.
566	    pub fn error_message_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
567	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
568	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::ErrorMessage.data_attrs();
569	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
570	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
571	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("error-message"));
572	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Live), "polite");
573	        attrs
574	    }
575	
576	    pub fn on_input_focus(&self, is_keyboard: bool) { (self.send)(Event::Focus { is_keyboard }); }
577	    pub fn on_input_blur(&self) { (self.send)(Event::Blur); }
578	    pub fn on_input_change(&self, text: String) { (self.send)(Event::Change(text)); }
579	    pub fn on_increment_click(&self) { (self.send)(Event::Increment); }
580	    pub fn on_decrement_click(&self) { (self.send)(Event::Decrement); }
581	
582	    pub fn on_input_keydown(&self, data: &KeyboardEventData) {
583	        let event = match data.key {
584	            KeyboardKey::ArrowUp => Some(Event::Increment),
585	            KeyboardKey::ArrowDown => Some(Event::Decrement),
586	            KeyboardKey::PageUp => Some(Event::IncrementLarge),
587	            KeyboardKey::PageDown => Some(Event::DecrementLarge),
588	            KeyboardKey::Home => Some(Event::DecrementToMin),
589	            KeyboardKey::End => Some(Event::IncrementToMax),
590	            _ => None,
591	        };
592	        if let Some(e) = event { (self.send)(e); }
593	    }
594	}
595	
596	impl ConnectApi for Api<'_> {
597	    type Part = Part;
598	
599	    fn part_attrs(&self, part: Part) -> AttrMap {
600	        match part {
601	            Part::Root => self.root_attrs(),
602	            Part::Label => self.label_attrs(),
603	            Part::Input => self.input_attrs(),
604	            Part::IncrementTrigger => self.increment_trigger_attrs(),
605	            Part::DecrementTrigger => self.decrement_trigger_attrs(),
606	            Part::Description => self.description_attrs(),
607	            Part::ErrorMessage => self.error_message_attrs(),
608	        }
609	    }
610	}

613	## 2. Anatomy
614	
615	```text
616	NumberInput
617	├── Root               <div>     data-ars-scope="number-input" data-ars-part="root"
618	├── Label              <label>   data-ars-part="label"
619	├── Input         [A]  <input>   data-ars-part="input" (role="spinbutton")
620	├── IncrementTrigger   <button>  data-ars-part="increment-trigger" (optional)
621	├── DecrementTrigger   <button>  data-ars-part="decrement-trigger" (optional)
622	├── Description        <div>     data-ars-part="description" (optional)
623	└── ErrorMessage       <div>     data-ars-part="error-message" (optional)
624	```
625	
626	| Part             | Element    | Key Attributes                                             |
627	| ---------------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
628	| Root             | `<div>`    | `data-ars-scope="number-input"`, `data-ars-state`          |
629	| Label            | `<label>`  | `for` points to Input                                      |
630	| Input            | `<input>`  | `role="spinbutton"`, `aria-valuenow/min/max/text`          |
631	| IncrementTrigger | `<button>` | `aria-label`, disabled at max boundary (optional)          |
632	| DecrementTrigger | `<button>` | `aria-label`, disabled at min boundary (optional)          |
633	| Description      | `<div>`    | Help text; linked via `aria-describedby` (optional)        |
634	| ErrorMessage     | `<div>`    | Validation error; linked via `aria-describedby` (optional) |
635	
636	**Press-and-hold**: When the user holds a stepper button, the adapter starts a repeat timer
637	(initial delay 400ms, then repeat every 60ms) sending `Event::Increment` or
638	`Event::Decrement`. The timer is cancelled on pointerup or pointerleave.
639	
640	## 3. Accessibility
641	
642	### 3.1 ARIA Roles, States, and Properties
643	
644	| Property           | Element | Value                                    |
645	| ------------------ | ------- | ---------------------------------------- |
646	| `role`             | Input   | `spinbutton`                             |
647	| `aria-valuenow`    | Input   | Current numeric value                    |
648	| `aria-valuemin`    | Input   | Minimum value (when finite)              |
649	| `aria-valuemax`    | Input   | Maximum value (when finite)              |
650	| `aria-valuetext`   | Input   | Locale-formatted value string            |
651	| `aria-required`    | Input   | Present when `required=true`             |
652	| `aria-invalid`     | Input   | Present when `invalid=true`              |
653	| `aria-labelledby`  | Input   | Points to Label id                       |
654	| `aria-describedby` | Input   | Points to Description + ErrorMessage ids |
655	
656	### 3.2 Keyboard Interaction
657	
658	| Key            | Action                     |
659	| -------------- | -------------------------- |
660	| ArrowUp        | Increment by step          |
661	| ArrowDown      | Decrement by step          |
662	| PageUp         | Increment by large step    |
663	| PageDown       | Decrement by large step    |
664	| Home           | Set to minimum             |
665	| End            | Set to maximum             |
666	| Tab            | Move focus                 |
667	| Ctrl+V / Cmd+V | Paste (locale-aware parse) |
668	
669	### 3.3 Paste Event Handling
670	
671	When the user pastes content into the NumberInput, the adapter intercepts the `paste` event:
672	
673	1. **Extract clipboard text**: Read plain-text content from the clipboard.
674	2. **Strip whitespace**: Trim leading/trailing whitespace.
675	3. **Locale-aware parse**: Pass the trimmed text through `number::Formatter::parse()` using the resolved locale. This handles locale-specific decimal separators, grouping separators, currency symbols, and percentage signs.
676	4. **Validation**: If `parse()` returns `Ok(value)`: clamp to `[min, max]`, round to `precision`, send `Event::SetValue(parsed_value)`, call `event.preventDefault()`.
677	5. **Rejection**: If `parse()` returns `Err`: call `event.preventDefault()` to reject the paste entirely. Optionally announce "Invalid paste content" via a live region.
678	
679	### 3.4 Scrubbing Accessibility
680	
681	During Scrubbing state, the input's `aria-valuenow` updates in real time.
682	Adapters may throttle `aria-valuetext` updates to avoid excessive screen reader
683	announcements.
684	
685	> **Passive wheel listener requirement:** When `allow_mouse_wheel: true`, the adapter attaches a `wheel` event listener with `{ passive: false }` to ensure `preventDefault()` is not silently ignored. This mirrors the passive listener guidance for touch events in `05-interactions.md` §2.4.
686	
687	## 4. Internationalization
688	
689	- **Locale resolution**: The adapter resolves locale from `ArsProvider` and passes it
690	  via `Env.locale` to `Machine::init()`, which stores it in `Context.locale`. All formatting
691	  and parsing uses this resolved locale.
692	- **Decimal separator**: Uses locale-appropriate separator (`,` vs `.`).
693	- **Thousands separator**: Applied when formatting the displayed value.
694	- **`aria-valuetext`**: Adapters derive a memoized formatter from `ArsProvider`
695	  via `use_number_formatter(|| number::FormatOptions::default())` and use it for
696	  locale-aware value text.
697	- **RTL**: Increment/decrement button positions swap visually (CSS `direction` handles this).
698	- **Input parsing**: Must accept both locale-specific input (e.g., `1.234,56` in `de-DE`) and
699	  canonical format (e.g., `1234.56`). On blur, the value is normalized to the canonical `f64`
700	  and the display is re-formatted per locale.
701	
702	### 4.1 Locale-Aware Number Formatting
703	
704	`NumberInput` MUST support locale-aware formatting and parsing of numeric values:
705	
706	- `en-US`: `1,234.56` (comma grouping, dot decimal)
707	- `de-DE`: `1.234,56` (dot grouping, comma decimal)
708	- `fr-FR`: `1 234,56` (narrow no-break space grouping, comma decimal)
709	
710	**Locale Resolution Chain**:
711	
712	1. `locale` prop (highest priority)
713	2. `FormContext.locale` (if inside a Form)
714	3. `ArsProvider` context
715	4. Fallback: `en-US`
716	
717	**Non-Uniform Digit Grouping**: Number formatting and parsing delegate to ICU4X
718	`number::Formatter`, which handles locale-specific grouping (including non-uniform patterns
719	like Indian numbering: `12,34,567`). The component must not hardcode grouping assumptions.
720	When locale is inherited from `ArsProvider`, adapters should resolve this
721	through `use_number_formatter(...)` rather than constructing ad hoc ambient
722	formatters from a thread-local cache.
723	
724	**Negative Number Sign Placement**: Negative number display follows locale conventions via
725	ICU4X — leading minus, trailing minus, or accounting parentheses. Adapters must not hardcode minus sign position.
726	
727	## 5. Form Integration
728	
729	- **Hidden input**: The `Input` part is the native `<input>` element and participates directly in form submission via its `name` attribute. The submitted value is the raw numeric string.
730	- **Validation states**: `aria-invalid="true"` on the Input when `invalid=true`. Native constraint validation is supplemented by the `min`/`max` bounds and `precision` rounding.
731	- **Error message association**: `aria-describedby` on Input points to `Description` (when present) and `ErrorMessage` (when invalid).
732	- **Required**: `aria-required="true"` on Input.
733	- **Reset behavior**: On form reset, the adapter restores `value` to `default_value`.
734	- **Disabled/readonly propagation**: When inside a `Field` or `Fieldset`, the adapter merges `disabled`/`readonly` from `FieldCtx` per `07-forms.md` §12.6.
735	
736	## 6. Library Parity
737	
738	> Compared against: Ark UI (`NumberInput`), React Aria (`NumberField`).
739	
740	### 6.1 Props
741	
742	| Feature                    | ars-ui                                  | Ark UI             | React Aria                                | Notes                                  |
743	| -------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------------------ | ----------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
744	| Controlled value           | `value: Option<f64>`                    | `value: string`    | `value: number`                           | Full parity (ars-ui uses numeric type) |
745	| Default value              | `default_value: Option<f64>`            | `defaultValue`     | `defaultValue`                            | Full parity                            |
746	| Min/Max                    | `min`/`max`                             | `min`/`max`        | `minValue`/`maxValue`                     | Full parity                            |
747	| Step                       | `step: f64`                             | `step`             | `step`                                    | Full parity                            |
748	| Large step                 | `large_step: f64`                       | --                 | --                                        | ars-ui enhancement for PageUp/PageDown |
749	| Disabled                   | `disabled: bool`                        | `disabled`         | `isDisabled`                              | Full parity                            |
750	| Read-only                  | `readonly: bool`                        | `readOnly`         | `isReadOnly`                              | Full parity                            |
751	| Required                   | `required: bool`                        | `required`         | `isRequired`                              | Full parity                            |
752	| Invalid                    | `invalid: bool`                         | `invalid`          | `isInvalid`                               | Full parity                            |
753	| Form name                  | `name: Option<String>`                  | `name`             | `name`                                    | Full parity                            |
754	| Form ID                    | `form: Option<String>`                  | `form`             | `form`                                    | Full parity                            |
755	| Mouse wheel                | `allow_mouse_wheel: bool`               | `allowMouseWheel`  | `isWheelDisabled` (inverted)              | Full parity (inverted boolean)         |
756	| Clamp on blur              | `clamp_value_on_blur: bool`             | `clampValueOnBlur` | --                                        | Ark parity                             |
757	| Spin on press              | `spin_on_press: bool`                   | `spinOnPress`      | --                                        | Ark parity                             |
758	| Format options             | `format_options: Option<FormatOptions>` | `formatOptions`    | `formatOptions`                           | Full parity                            |
759	| Locale                     | via `Env.locale` (adapter-resolved)     | `locale`           | --                                        | Ark parity (adapter prop, not core)    |
760	| Increment/decrement labels | via `Messages`                          | `translations`     | `incrementAriaLabel`/`decrementAriaLabel` | Full parity                            |
761	
762	**Gaps:** None.
763	
764	### 6.2 Anatomy
765	
766	| Part             | ars-ui                | Ark UI             | React Aria          | Notes                                                            |
767	| ---------------- | --------------------- | ------------------ | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
768	| Root             | `Root`                | `Root`             | `NumberField`       | Full parity                                                      |
769	| Label            | `Label`               | `Label`            | `Label`             | Full parity                                                      |
770	| Input            | `Input`               | `Input`            | `Input`             | Full parity                                                      |
771	| IncrementTrigger | `IncrementTrigger`    | `IncrementTrigger` | `Button[increment]` | Full parity                                                      |
772	| DecrementTrigger | `DecrementTrigger`    | `DecrementTrigger` | `Button[decrement]` | Full parity                                                      |
773	| Scrubber         | -- (scrub via events) | `Scrubber`         | --                  | ars-ui uses Scrubbing state + events instead of a dedicated part |
774	| Control          | --                    | `Control`          | `Group`             | Ark/RA wrapper; ars-ui Root serves this role                     |
775	| ValueText        | --                    | `ValueText`        | --                  | Ark display part; ars-ui uses input value directly               |
776	| Description      | `Description`         | --                 | `Text[description]` | ars-ui form-field part                                           |
777	| ErrorMessage     | `ErrorMessage`        | --                 | `FieldError`        | ars-ui form-field part                                           |
778	
779	**Gaps:** None material. Ark's `Scrubber` is a dedicated part; ars-ui achieves the same via `StartScrub`/`Scrub`/`EndScrub` events on the `Input` element. Ark's `ValueText` is a read-only display; ars-ui formats the value directly in the input.
780	
781	### 6.3 Events
782	
783	| Callback                 | ars-ui                          | Ark UI              | React Aria      | Notes                                  |
784	| ------------------------ | ------------------------------- | ------------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------- |
785	| Value changed            | `Change(String)`                | `onValueChange`     | `onChange`      | Full parity                            |
786	| Value committed          | via `Blur` + clamp              | `onValueCommit`     | --              | Ark parity                             |
787	| Value invalid (overflow) | via validation                  | `onValueInvalid`    | --              | Ark parity (handled via invalid state) |
788	| Focus change             | `Focus`/`Blur`                  | `onFocusChange`     | `onFocusChange` | Full parity                            |
789	| Scrub                    | `StartScrub`/`Scrub`/`EndScrub` | (via Scrubber part) | --              | Ark parity                             |
790	
791	**Gaps:** None.
792	
793	### 6.4 Features
794	
795	| Feature                 | ars-ui                                  | Ark UI | React Aria   |
796	| ----------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ------ | ------------ |
797	| Keyboard inc/dec        | Yes (arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End) | Yes    | Yes          |
798	| Press-and-hold spin     | Yes                                     | Yes    | Yes          |
799	| Mouse wheel             | Yes                                     | Yes    | Yes (opt-in) |
800	| Scrubbing               | Yes                                     | Yes    | --           |
801	| Locale-aware formatting | Yes                                     | Yes    | Yes          |
802	| Clamp on blur           | Yes                                     | Yes    | --           |
803	| Form integration        | Yes                                     | Yes    | Built-in     |
804	| IME composition         | Yes                                     | --     | --           |
805	
806	**Gaps:** None.
807	
808	### 6.5 Summary
809	
810	- **Overall:** Full parity with both reference libraries.
811	- **Divergences:** ars-ui uses `Option<f64>` for the value type (allowing empty state) instead of Ark's string-based representation. ars-ui adds `large_step` for PageUp/PageDown granularity and IME composition tracking. Scrubbing is handled via events rather than a dedicated `Scrubber` part.
812	- **Recommended additions:** None.
813
