decrement_label: MessageFn::static_str(\"Decrement\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl ComponentMessages for Messages {}\n\n/// The machine for the `NumberInput` component.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct Machine;\n\nimpl ars_core::Machine for Machine {\n    type State = State;\n    type Event = Event;\n    type Context = Context;\n    type Props = Props;\n    type Messages = Messages;\n    type Effect = NoEffect;\n    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;\n\n    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (State, Context) {\n        (\n            State::Idle,\n            Context {\n                value: if let Some(value) = props.value {\n                    Bindable::controlled(Some(value))\n                } else {\n                    Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value)\n                },\n                min: props.min,\n                max: props.max,\n                step: props.step,\n                large_step: props.large_step,\n                precision: props.precision,\n                disabled: props.disabled,\n                readonly: props.readonly,\n                invalid: props.invalid,\n                required: props.required,\n                focused: false,\n                focus_visible: false,\n                name: props.name.clone(),\n                spin_on_press: props.spin_on_press,\n                scrubbing: false,\n                is_composing: false,\n                has_description: false,\n                locale: env.locale.clone(),\n                messages: messages.clone(),\n                ids: ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id),\n            },\n        )\n    }\n\n    fn transition(\n        state: &State,\n        event: &Event,\n        ctx: &Context,\n        props: &Props,\n    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {\n        if ctx.disabled || ctx.readonly {\n            match event {\n                Event::Increment\n                | Event::Decrement\n                | Event::IncrementLarge\n                | Event::DecrementLarge\n                | Event::IncrementToMax\n                | Event::DecrementToMin\n                | Event::Change(_)\n                | Event::SetValue(_)\n                | Event::StartScrub\n                | Event::Scrub(_)\n                | Event::EndScrub\n                | Event::Wheel { .. } => return None,\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }\n\n        match event {\n            Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {\n                let is_keyboard = *is_keyboard;\n\n                Some(\n                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                        ctx.focused = true;\n                        ctx.focus_visible = is_keyboard;\n                    }),\n                )\n            }\n\n            Event::Blur => {\n                let clamp_on_blur = props.clamp_value_on_blur;\n                let min = ctx.min;\n                let max = ctx.max;\n                let precision = ctx.precision;\n                let current = *ctx.value.get();\n\n                Some(\n                    TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                        ctx.focused = false;\n                        ctx.focus_visible = false;\n\n                        if clamp_on_blur {\n                            if let Some(value) = current {\n                                let clamped = clamp(value, min, max);\n\n                                if (clamped - value).abs() > f64::EPSILON {\n                                    ctx.value.set(Some(round_to_precision(clamped, precision)));\n                                }\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }),\n                )\n            }\n\n            Event::Increment => stepped_plan(ctx, ctx.step, true),\n            Event::Decrement => stepped_plan(ctx, ctx.step, false),\n            Event::IncrementLarge => stepped_plan(ctx, ctx.large_step, true),\n            Event::DecrementLarge => stepped_plan(ctx, ctx.large_step, false),\n\n            Event::IncrementToMax => {\n                let target = ctx.max;\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.value.set(Some(target));\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::DecrementToMin => {\n                let target = ctx.min;\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.value.set(Some(target));\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::SetValue(value) => {\n                let value = round_to_precision(clamp(*value, ctx.min, ctx.max), ctx.precision);\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.value.set(Some(value));\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::Change(text) => {\n                let text = text.clone();\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    if text.is_empty() {\n                        ctx.value.set(None);\n                    } else if let Ok(value) = text.parse::<f64>() {\n                        ctx.value.set(Some(value));\n                    }\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::StartScrub => Some(\n                TransitionPlan::to(State::Scrubbing).apply(|ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.scrubbing = true;\n                }),\n            ),\n\n            Event::Scrub(delta) if matches!(state, State::Scrubbing) => {\n                let current = ctx.value.get().unwrap_or(0.0);\n                let next = round_to_precision(\n                    clamp(current + delta * ctx.step, ctx.min, ctx.max),\n                    ctx.precision,\n                );\n\n                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.value.set(Some(next));\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::EndScrub => {\n                let target = if ctx.focused {\n                    State::Focused\n                } else {\n                    State::Idle\n                };\n\n                Some(TransitionPlan::to(target).apply(|ctx: &mut Context| {\n                    ctx.scrubbing = false;\n                }))\n            }\n\n            Event::Wheel { delta }\n                if matches!(state, State::Focused) && props.allow_mouse_wheel =>\n            {\n                let stepped = if *delta > 0.0 {\n                    Event::Increment\n                } else if *delta < 0.0 {\n                    Event::Decrement\n                } else {\n                    return None;\n                };\n\n                Self::transition(state, &stepped, ctx, props)\n            }\n\n            Event::CompositionStart => Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx: &mut Context| {\n                ctx.is_composing = true;\n            })),\n\n            Event::CompositionEnd => Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx: &mut Context| {\n                ctx.is_composing = false;\n            })),\n\n            Event::Scrub(_) | Event::Wheel { .. } => None,\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn connect<'a>(\n        state: &'a State,\n        ctx: &'a Context,\n        props: &'a Props,\n        send: &'a dyn Fn(Event),\n    ) -> Api<'a> {\n        Api {\n            state,\n            ctx,\n            props,\n            send,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Round-half-up: ties move away from zero.\n///\n/// Banker's rounding (`f64::round_ties_even`) is unsuitable for interactive UI\n/// because end users expect `2.5` to round to `3` rather than `2`. See\n/// `spec/components/input/number-input.md` §1.5 for the rationale.\nfn round_to_precision(value: f64, precision: Option<u32>) -> f64 {\n    let Some(p) = precision else {\n        return value;\n    };\n\n    let factor = 10_f64.powi(p as i32);\n\n    (value * factor + 0.5_f64.copysign(value)).trunc() / factor\n}\n\nfn clamp(value: f64, min: f64, max: f64) -> f64 {\n    value.max(min).min(max)\n}\n\nfn stepped_plan(ctx: &Context, step: f64, up: bool) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Machine>> {\n    let current = ctx.value.get().unwrap_or(ctx.min);\n    let raw = if up { current + step } else { current - step };\n    let next = round_to_precision(clamp(raw, ctx.min, ctx.max), ctx.precision);\n\n    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx: &mut Context| {\n        ctx.value.set(Some(next));\n    }))\n}\n\n/// Structural parts exposed by the `NumberInput` connect API.\n#[derive(ComponentPart)]\n#[scope = \"number-input\"]\npub enum Part {\n    /// The root container element.\n    Root,\n\n    /// The visible label element.\n    Label,\n\n    /// The native `<input>` element (carries `role=\"spinbutton\"`).\n    Input,\n\n    /// The optional increment button.\n    IncrementTrigger,\n\n    /// The optional decrement button.\n    DecrementTrigger,\n\n    /// The optional descriptive help-text element.\n    Description,\n\n    /// The optional send: &'a dyn Fn(Event),\n}\n\nimpl Debug for Api<'_> {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        f.debug_struct(\"Api\")\n            .field(\"state\", &self.state)\n type Part = Part;\n\n    fn part_attrs(&self, part: Part) -> AttrMap {\n        match part {\n            Part::Root => self.root_attrs(),\n            Part::Label => self.label_attrs(),\n            Part::Input => self.input_attrs(),\n            Part::IncrementTrigger => self.increment_trigger_attrs(),\n            Part::DecrementTrigger => self.decrement_trigger_attrs(),\n            Part::Description => self.description_attrs(),\n            Part::ErrorMessage => self.error_message_attrs(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Api<'_> {\n    /// Attributes for the root container.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();\n\n        attrs\n            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)\n            .set(part_attr, part_val)\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.id())\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Data(\"ars-state\"), self.state.to_string());\n\n        if self.ctx.disabled {\n            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data(\"ars-disabled\"), true);\n        }\n\n        if self.ctx.invalid {\n            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data(\"ars-invalid\"), true);\n        }\n\n        if self.ctx.readonly {\n            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data(\"ars-readonly\"), true);\n        }\n\n        if self.ctx.focus_visible {\n            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data(\"ars-focus-visible\"), true);\n        }\n\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for the label element.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn label_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Label.data_attrs();\n\n        attrs\n            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)\n            .set(part_attr, part_val)\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part(\"label\"))\n            .set(HtmlAttr::For, self.ctx.ids.part(\"input\"));\n\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for the native `<input>` element.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn input_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Input.data_attrs();\n\n        attrs\n            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)\n            .set(part_attr, part_val)\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part(\"input\"))\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Role, \"spinbutton\")\n            .set(HtmlAttr::InputMode, \"decimal\")\n            .set(\n                HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::LabelledBy),\n                self.ctx.ids.part(\"label\"),\n            );\n\n        if let Some(value) = self.ctx.value.get() {\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueNow), value.to_string());\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Value, value.to_string());\n        }\n\n        if self.ctx.min.is_finite() {\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueMin), self.ctx.min.to_string());\n        }\n\n        if self.ctx.max.is_finite() {\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ValueMax), self.ctx.max.to_string());\n        }\n\n        set_described_by(&mut attrs, self.ctx);\n\n        if self.ctx.required {\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Required), \"true\");\n        }\n\n        if self.ctx.invalid {\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Invalid), \"true\");\n            attrs.set(\n                HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ErrorMessage),\n                self.ctx.ids.part(\"error-message\"),\n            );\n        }\n\n        if self.ctx.disabled {\n            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Disabled, true);\n        }\n\n        if self.ctx.readonly {\n            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::ReadOnly, true);\n        }\n\n        if let Some(name) = &self.ctx.name {\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Name, name.clone());\n        }\n\n        if let Some(form) = &self.props.form {\n            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Form, form.clone());\n        }\n\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for the increment trigger button.\n    ///\n    /// Adapters drive press-and-hold spin from [`Context::spin_on_press`]; the\n    /// agnostic core only emits the per-click intent.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn increment_trigger_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        self.trigger_attrs(\n            &Part::IncrementTrigger,\n            &self.ctx.messages.increment_label,\n            self.is_at_max(),\n        )\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for the decrement trigger button.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn decrement_trigger_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        self.trigger_attrs(\n            &Part::DecrementTrigger,\n            &self.ctx.messages.decrement_label,\n            self.is_at_min(),\n        )\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for the description/help text element.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn description_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Description.data_attrs();\n\n        attrs\n            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)\n            .set(part_attr, part_val)\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part(\"description\"));\n\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for the validation error message element.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn error_message_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::ErrorMessage.data_attrs();\n\n        attrs\n            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)\n            .set(part_attr, part_val)\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part(\"error-message\"))\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Live), \"polite\");\n\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Sends [`Event::Focus`] for input focus.\n    pub fn on_input_focus(&self, is_keyboard: bool) {\n        (self.send)(Event::Focus { is_keyboard });\n    }\n\n    /// Sends [`Event::Blur`] for input blur.\n    pub fn on_input_blur(&self) {\n        (self.send)(Event::Blur);\n    }\n\n    /// Sends [`Event::Change`] for input changes.\n    pub fn on_input_change(&self, value: String) {\n        (self.send)(Event::Change(value));\n    }\n\n    /// Sends [`Event::Increment`] for increment trigger activation.\n    pub fn on_increment_click(&self) {\n        (self.send)(Event::Increment);\n    }\n\n    /// Sends [`Event::Decrement`] for decrement trigger activation.\n    pub fn on_decrement_click(&self) {\n        (self.send)(Event::Decrement);\n    }\n\n    /// Handles normalized keydown data on the input element.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `true` when the key was handled by the core machine.\n    pub fn on_input_keydown(&self, data: &KeyboardEventData) -> bool {\n        if data.is_composing {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n -> String + Send + Sync>,\n        at_boundary: bool,\n    ) -> AttrMap {\n        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();\n        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = part.data_attrs();\n\n        attrs\n            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)\n            .set(part_attr, part_val)\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Type, \"button\")\n            .set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, \"-1\")\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label), label(&self.ctx.locale));\n\n        if self.ctx.disabled || self.ctx.readonly || at_boundary {\n self.ctx.min)\n    }\n}\n\nfn set_described_by(attrs: &mut AttrMap, ctx: &Context) {\n    let mut described_by = Vec::new();\n\n    if ctx.has_description {\n attrs.set(\n            HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy),\n            described_by.join(\" \"),\n        );\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use alloc::string::ToString;\n\n    use 25	///
26	/// Named `KeyboardEventData` instead of `KeyboardEvent` to avoid collisions
27	/// with framework or DOM event types such as `web_sys::KeyboardEvent`.
28	#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
29	pub struct KeyboardEventData {
30	    /// The named key, normalized from W3C `KeyboardEvent.key` values.
31	    ///
32	    /// Printable character keys use [`KeyboardKey::Unidentified`] and place the
33	    /// final character in [`Self::character`] instead.
34	    pub key: KeyboardKey,
35	
36	    /// The printable character produced by this key press, if any.
37	    ///
38	    /// For example, `A` maps to `Some('a')` or `Some('A')`, `Space` maps to
39	    /// `Some(' ')`, and named control keys such as `Enter` map to `None`.
40	    pub character: Option<char>,
41	
42	    /// The physical key code, such as `"KeyA"` or `"Digit1"`.
43	    ///
44	    /// This uses the browser `KeyboardEvent.code` contract rather than the
45	    /// localized `KeyboardEvent.key` value.
46	    pub code: String,
47	
48	    /// Whether the Shift modifier was held.
49	    pub shift_key: bool,
50	
51	    /// Whether the physical Ctrl key was held.
52	    ///
53	    /// This is the raw Ctrl state, not a platform-abstracted action modifier.
54	    /// Consumers that want Ctrl on Windows/Linux and Cmd on macOS should use
55	    /// the higher-level action-key abstractions provided elsewhere.
56	    pub ctrl_key: bool,
57	
58	    /// Whether the Alt modifier was held.
59	    pub alt_key: bool,
60	
61	    /// Whether the Meta modifier was held.
62	    pub meta_key: bool,
63	
64	    /// Whether this event is an auto-repeat generated by holding the key down.
65	    pub repeat: bool,
66	
67	    /// Whether this event fired during active IME composition.
68	    ///
69	    /// Components must suppress character-driven interactions while this is
70	    /// `true`, because the user is still composing a multi-keystroke character.
71	    pub is_composing: bool,
72	}

74	/// Keyboard events emitted by the standalone keyboard interaction.
75	///
76	/// Named `ArsKeyboardEvent` to avoid collisions with DOM and framework event
77	/// types while preserving a small, framework-agnostic enum surface. Adapters
78	/// converting from DOM events should use the full path `web_sys::KeyboardEvent`
79	/// for the DOM type and this type for the normalized event.
80	#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
81	pub enum ArsKeyboardEvent {
82	    /// A key was pressed down.
83	    KeyDown(KeyboardEventData),
84	
85	    /// A key was released.
86	    KeyUp(KeyboardEventData),
87	}

92	
93	/// Trigger half of a [`Hotkey`].
94	///
95	/// A hotkey's trigger is either a *named* (non-printable) key like `Enter`
96	/// or `F8`, or a *printable character* like `'t'` for `Alt+T`. The two
97	/// cases live in different fields on [`KeyboardEventData`]
98	/// ([`KeyboardEventData::key`] vs [`KeyboardEventData::character`]) so the
99	/// trigger is sum-typed to make matching unambiguous.
100	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
101	pub enum HotkeyTrigger {
102	    /// A named (non-printable) key — `Enter`, `Escape`, `F8`, `ArrowUp`,
103	    /// etc. Matched against [`KeyboardEventData::key`].
104	    Named(KeyboardKey),
105	
106	    /// A printable character — matched case-insensitively (ASCII) against
107	    /// [`KeyboardEventData::character`]. Useful for chords like `Alt+T`
108	    /// where the consumer wants the chord to fire regardless of whether
109	    /// Caps Lock is on.
110	    Char(char),
111	}

228	### 1.5 Full Machine Implementation
229	
230	```rust
231	/// Machine for the PinInput component.
232	pub struct Machine;
233	
234	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
235	    type State = State;
236	    type Event = Event;
237	    type Context = Context;
238	    type Props = Props;
239	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
240	    type Messages = Messages;
241	
242	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
243	        let locale = env.locale.clone();
244	        let messages = messages.clone();
245	        let initial = props.value.clone()
246	            .unwrap_or_else(|| {
247	                let mut v = props.default_value.clone();
248	                v.resize(props.length, String::new());
249	                v
250	            });
251	        let complete = initial.iter().all(|v| !v.is_empty());
252	        let state = if complete { State::Completed } else { State::Idle };
253	        let ctx = Context {
254	            value: match &props.value {
255	                Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v.clone()),
256	                None => Bindable::uncontrolled(initial),
257	            },
258	            length: props.length,
259	            disabled: props.disabled,
260	            invalid: props.invalid,
261	            otp: props.otp,
262	            mask: props.mask,
263	            placeholder: props.placeholder.clone(),
264	            focused_index: None,
265	            focus_visible: false,
266	            complete,
267	            mode: props.mode.clone(),
268	            name: props.name.clone(),
269	            select_on_focus: props.select_on_focus,
270	            blur_on_complete: props.blur_on_complete,
271	            is_composing: false,
272	            has_description: false,
273	            locale,
274	            messages,
275	            ids: ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id),
276	        };
277	        (state, ctx)
278	    }
279	
280	    fn transition(
281	        state: &Self::State,
282	        event: &Self::Event,
283	        ctx: &Self::Context,
284	        props: &Self::Props,
285	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
286	        // Disabled guard
287	        if ctx.disabled {
288	            match event {
289	                Event::InputChar { .. } | Event::DeleteChar { .. }
290	                | Event::Paste(_) | Event::Clear | Event::Complete(_) => return None,
291	                _ => {}
292	            }
293	        }
294	
295	        match (state, event) {
296	            // ── Focus / Blur ──────────────────────────────────────
297	            // When `ctx.select_on_focus` is true, the adapter calls `.select()` on the
298	            // input element after this transition completes. The machine only sets state;
299	            // the adapter reads `ctx.select_on_focus` in its focus event handler.
300	            (_, Event::Focus { index, is_keyboard }) => {
301	                let idx = *index;
302	                let is_kb = *is_keyboard;
303	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused { index: idx }).apply(move |ctx| {
304	                    ctx.focused_index = Some(idx);
305	                    ctx.focus_visible = is_kb;
306	                }))
307	            }
308	            (_, Event::Blur) => {
309	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(if ctx.complete { State::Completed } else { State::Idle })
310	                    .apply(|ctx| {
311	                        ctx.focused_index = None;
312	                        ctx.focus_visible = false;
313	                    }))
314	            }
315	
316	            // ── InputChar ─────────────────────────────────────────
317	            (State::Focused { .. }, Event::InputChar { index, char: c }) => {
318	                let c = *c;
319	                let i = *index;
320	                let length = ctx.length;
321	                let mut vals = ctx.value.get().clone();
322	                vals[i] = c.to_string();
323	
324	                if vals.iter().all(|v| !v.is_empty()) {
325	                    let combined = vals.iter().map(|v| v.as_str()).collect::<String>();
326	                    let blur = ctx.blur_on_complete;
327	                    let mut plan = TransitionPlan::to(State::Completed).apply(move |ctx| {
328	                        ctx.value.set(vals);
329	                        ctx.complete = true;
330	                    }).with_effect(PendingEffect::new("complete", move |_ctx, props, _send| {
331	                        if let Some(ref cb) = props.on_value_complete {
332	                            let cb = cb.clone();
333	                            Box::new(move || { cb(&combined); })
334	                        } else {
335	                            no_cleanup()
336	                        }
337	                    }));
338	                    if blur {
339	                        plan = plan.with_effect(PendingEffect::new("blur-on-complete", |_ctx, _props, _send| {
340	                            let platform = use_platform_effects();
341	                            platform.focus_body();
342	                            no_cleanup()
343	                        }));
344	                    }
345	                    Some(plan)
346	                } else {
347	                    let next = (i + 1..length).find(|j| vals[*j].is_empty()).unwrap_or(i);
348	                    Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused { index: next }).apply(move |ctx| {
349	                        ctx.value.set(vals);
350	                        ctx.focused_index = Some(next);
351	                    }).with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus_element", |ctx, _props, _send| {
352	                        let platform = use_platform_effects();
353	                        let input_id = ctx.ids.item("input", ctx.focused_index.unwrap_or(0));
354	                        platform.focus_element_by_id(&input_id);
355	                        no_cleanup()
356	                    })))
357	                }
358	            }
359	
360	            // ── DeleteChar ────────────────────────────────────────
361	            (_, Event::DeleteChar { index }) => {
362	                let index = *index;
363	                let vals = ctx.value.get().clone();
364	                if vals[index].is_empty() && index > 0 {
365	                    let prev = index - 1;
366	                    Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused { index: prev }).apply(move |ctx| {
367	                        let mut vals = ctx.value.get().clone();
368	                        vals[prev] = String::new();
369	                        ctx.value.set(vals);
370	                        ctx.focused_index = Some(prev);
371	                        ctx.complete = false;
372	                    }).with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus_element", |ctx, _props, _send| {
373	                        let platform = use_platform_effects();
374	                        let input_id = ctx.ids.item("input", ctx.focused_index.unwrap_or(0));
375	                        platform.focus_element_by_id(&input_id);
376	                        no_cleanup()
377	                    })))
378	                } else {
379	                    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
380	                        let mut vals = ctx.value.get().clone();
381	                        vals[index] = String::new();
382	                        ctx.value.set(vals);
383	                        ctx.complete = false;
384	                    }))
385	                }
386	            }
387	
388	            // ── Paste ─────────────────────────────────────────────
389	            (_, Event::Paste(text)) => {
390	                let mode = ctx.mode.clone();
391	                let chars = text.chars::<Vec<_>>()
392	                    .filter(|c| match mode {
393	                        Mode::Numeric => c.is_ascii_digit(),
394	                        Mode::Alphanumeric => c.is_alphanumeric(),
395	                        Mode::Password => true,
396	                    })
397	                    .take(ctx.length)
398	                    .collect();
399	                let mut vals = ctx.value.get().clone();
400	                let start = ctx.focused_index.unwrap_or(0);
401	                let length = ctx.length;
402	                for (i, ch) in chars.iter().enumerate() {
403	                    if start + i < length { vals[start + i] = ch.to_string(); }
404	                }
405	
406	                if vals.iter().all(|v| !v.is_empty()) {
407	                    let combined = vals.iter().map(|v| v.as_str()).collect::<String>();
408	                    let blur = ctx.blur_on_complete;
409	                    let mut plan = TransitionPlan::to(State::Completed).apply(move |ctx| {
410	                        ctx.value.set(vals);
411	                        ctx.complete = true;
412	                    }).with_effect(PendingEffect::new("complete", move |_ctx, props, _send| {
413	                        if let Some(ref cb) = props.on_value_complete {
414	                            let cb = cb.clone();
415	                            Box::new(move || { cb(&combined); })
416	                        } else { no_cleanup() }
417	                    }));
418	                    if blur {
419	                        plan = plan.with_effect(PendingEffect::new("blur-on-complete", |_ctx, _props, _send| {
420	                            let platform = use_platform_effects();
421	                            platform.focus_body();
422	                            no_cleanup()
423	                        }));
424	                    }
425	                    Some(plan)
426	                } else {
427	                    Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| { ctx.value.set(vals); }))
428	                }
429	            }
430	
431	            // ── Clear ─────────────────────────────────────────────
432	            (_, Event::Clear) => {
433	                let length = ctx.length;
434	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(move |ctx| {
435	                    ctx.value.set(vec![String::new(); length]);
436	                    ctx.complete = false;
437	                    ctx.focused_index = None;
438	                }))
439	            }
440	
441	            // ── Navigation ────────────────────────────────────────
442	            (_, Event::FocusPrev) => {
443	                let current = ctx.focused_index.unwrap_or(0);
444	                if current == 0 { return None; }
445	                let prev = current - 1;
446	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused { index: prev }).apply(move |ctx| {
447	                    ctx.focused_index = Some(prev);
448	                }).with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus_element", |ctx, _props, _send| {
449	                    let platform = use_platform_effects();
450	                    let input_id = ctx.ids.item("input", ctx.focused_index.unwrap_or(0));
451	                    platform.focus_element_by_id(&input_id);
452	                    no_cleanup()
453	                })))
454	            }
455	
456	            (_, Event::FocusNext) => {
457	                let current = ctx.focused_index.unwrap_or(0);
458	                if current + 1 >= ctx.length { return None; }
459	                let next = current + 1;
460	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused { index: next }).apply(move |ctx| {
461	                    ctx.focused_index = Some(next);
462	                }).with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus_element", |ctx, _props, _send| {
463	                    let platform = use_platform_effects();
464	                    let input_id = ctx.ids.item("input", ctx.focused_index.unwrap_or(0));
465	                    platform.focus_element_by_id(&input_id);
466	                    no_cleanup()
467	                })))
468	            }
469	
470	            // ── IME Composition ───────────────────────────────────
471	            (_, Event::CompositionStart) => {
472	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| { ctx.is_composing = true; }))
473	            }
474	            (_, Event::CompositionEnd) => {
475	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| { ctx.is_composing = false; }))
476	            }
477	
478	            _ => None,
479	        }
480	    }
481	
482	    fn connect<'a>(
483	        state: &'a Self::State,
484	        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
485	        props: &'a Self::Props,
486	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
487	    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
488	        Api { state, ctx, props, send }
489	    }
490	}
491	```

493	### 1.6 Connect / API
494	
495	```rust
496	#[derive(ComponentPart)]
497	#[scope = "pin-input"]
498	pub enum Part {
499	    Root,
500	    Label,
501	    Input { cell_index: usize },       // cell index
502	    HiddenInput,
503	    Description,
504	    ErrorMessage,
505	}
506	
507	/// The API for the PinInput component.
508	pub struct Api<'a> {
509	    state: &'a State,
510	    ctx: &'a Context,
511	    props: &'a Props,
512	    send: &'a dyn Fn(Event),
513	}
514	
515	impl<'a> Api<'a> {
516	    /// Attributes for the root container.
517	    pub fn root_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
518	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
519	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Root.data_attrs();
520	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
521	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
522	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "group");
523	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-state"), match self.state {
524	            State::Idle => "idle",
525	            State::Focused { .. } => "focused",
526	            State::Completed => "completed",
527	        });
528	        if self.ctx.disabled { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-disabled"), true); }
529	        if self.ctx.invalid { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-invalid"), true); }
530	        if self.ctx.focus_visible { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focus-visible"), true); }
531	        attrs
532	    }
533	
534	    /// Attributes for the group label.
535	    pub fn label_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
536	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
537	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Label.data_attrs();
538	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
539	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
540	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("label"));
541	        attrs
542	    }
543	
544	    /// Attributes for a single cell input.
545	    pub fn input_attrs(&self, index: usize) -> AttrMap {
546	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
547	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Input { cell_index: index }.data_attrs();
548	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
549	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
550	        let input_id = self.ctx.ids.item("input", index);
551	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, input_id);
552	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-index"), index.to_string());
553	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Type, if self.ctx.mask { "password" } else { "text" });
554	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::InputMode, match self.ctx.mode {
555	            Mode::Numeric => "numeric",
556	            Mode::Alphanumeric | Mode::Password => "text",
557	        });
558	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::MaxLength, "1");
559	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label),
560	            (self.ctx.messages.ordinal_label)(index + 1, self.ctx.length, &self.ctx.locale));
561	        if self.ctx.otp { attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Autocomplete, "one-time-code"); }
562	        if self.ctx.invalid { attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Invalid), "true"); }
563	        if self.ctx.disabled { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Disabled, true); }
564	        if self.props.readonly { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::ReadOnly, true); attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::ReadOnly), "true"); }
565	        let is_focused = self.ctx.focused_index == Some(index);
566	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, if is_focused { "0" } else { "-1" });
567	        if let Some(ref val) = self.ctx.value.get().get(index) {
568	            if !val.is_empty() {
569	                attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Value, val);
570	            }
571	        }
572	        if let Some(ref ph) = self.ctx.placeholder {
573	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Placeholder, ph);
574	        }
575	        attrs
576	    }
577	
578	    /// Attributes for the hidden input (form submission).
579	    pub fn hidden_input_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
580	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
581	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::HiddenInput.data_attrs();
582	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
583	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
584	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Type, "hidden");
585	        let combined = self.ctx.value.get().iter().map(|v| v.as_str()).collect::<String>();
586	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Value, combined);
587	        if let Some(ref name) = self.ctx.name { attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Name, name); }
588	        if let Some(ref form) = self.props.form { attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Form, form); }
589	        if self.props.required { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Required, true); }
590	        if self.ctx.disabled { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Disabled, true); }
591	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Hidden), "true");
592	        attrs
593	    }
594	
595	    /// Attributes for the description/help text.
596	    pub fn description_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
597	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
598	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Description.data_attrs();
599	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
600	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
601	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("description"));
602	        attrs
603	    }
604	
605	    /// Attributes for the error message element.
606	    pub fn error_message_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
607	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
608	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::ErrorMessage.data_attrs();
609	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
610	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
611	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("error-message"));
612	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Live), "polite");
613	        attrs
614	    }
615	
616	    pub fn on_cell_keydown(&self, index: usize, data: &KeyboardEventData) {
617	        match data.key {
618	            KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft => (self.send)(Event::FocusPrev),
619	            KeyboardKey::ArrowRight => (self.send)(Event::FocusNext),
620	            KeyboardKey::Backspace | KeyboardKey::Delete => (self.send)(Event::DeleteChar { index }),
621	            _ => {}
622	        }
623	    }
624	
625	    pub fn on_cell_focus(&self, index: usize, is_keyboard: bool) {
626	        (self.send)(Event::Focus { index, is_keyboard });
627	    }
628	
629	    pub fn on_cell_blur(&self) { (self.send)(Event::Blur); }
630	
631	    pub fn on_cell_input(&self, index: usize, ch: char) {
632	        (self.send)(Event::InputChar { index, char: ch });
633	    }
634	
635	    pub fn on_paste(&self, text: String) { (self.send)(Event::Paste(text)); }
636	}

638	impl ConnectApi for Api<'_> {

640	
641	    fn part_attrs(&self, part: Part) -> AttrMap {
642	        match part {
643	            Part::Root => self.root_attrs(),
644	            Part::Label => self.label_attrs(),
645	            Part::Input { cell_index } => self.input_attrs(cell_index),
646	            Part::HiddenInput => self.hidden_input_attrs(),
647	            Part::Description => self.description_attrs(),
648	            Part::ErrorMessage => self.error_message_attrs(),
649	        }
650	    }

653	
654	## 2. Anatomy
655	
656	```text
657	PinInput
658	├── Root               <div>    data-ars-scope="pin-input" data-ars-part="root" (role="group")
659	├── Label              <label>  data-ars-part="label"
660	├── Input (×N)         <input>  data-ars-part="input" data-ars-index="{n}"
661	├── HiddenInput        <input>  data-ars-part="hidden-input" (type="hidden", aria-hidden)
662	├── Description        <div>    data-ars-part="description" (optional)
663	└── ErrorMessage       <div>    data-ars-part="error-message" (optional)
664	```
665	
666	| Part         | Element   | Key Attributes                                             |
667	| ------------ | --------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
668	| Root         | `<div>`   | `role="group"`, `data-ars-state`                           |
669	| Label        | `<label>` | Group label                                                |
670	| Input        | `<input>` | Per-cell; `aria-label`, `maxlength="1"`, roving tabindex   |
671	| HiddenInput  | `<input>` | `type="hidden"` — combined value for form submission       |
672	| Description  | `<div>`   | Help text; linked via `aria-describedby` (optional)        |
673	| ErrorMessage | `<div>`   | Validation error; linked via `aria-describedby` (optional) |
674	
675	## 3. Accessibility
676	
677	### 3.1 ARIA Roles, States, and Properties
678	
679	| Property       | Element | Value                                                   |
680	| -------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
681	| `role`         | Root    | `group`                                                 |
682	| `aria-label`   | Input   | "Digit {n} of {total}" (localized via `ordinal_label`)  |
683	| `autocomplete` | Input   | `"one-time-code"` when `otp=true`                       |
684	| `inputmode`    | Input   | `"numeric"` (Numeric), `"text"` (Alphanumeric/Password) |
685	| `aria-invalid` | Input   | Present when group is invalid                           |
686	| `tabindex`     | Input   | Roving: focused cell `0`, all others `-1`               |
687	
688	### 3.2 Keyboard Interaction
689	
690	| Key            | Action                         |
691	| -------------- | ------------------------------ |
692	| 0-9 / a-z      | Fill cell, auto-advance        |
693	| Backspace      | Clear cell or move to previous |
694	| Delete         | Clear current cell             |
695	| ArrowLeft      | Move to previous cell          |
696	| ArrowRight     | Move to next cell              |
697	| Ctrl+V / Cmd+V | Paste across cells             |
698	
699	### 3.3 Screen Reader Guidance
700	
701	1. Each input field has `aria-label` in format `"Digit {n} of {total}"` (localized via `ars-i18n`).
702	2. On auto-advance, the screen reader announces the new field via focus move.
703	3. On paste, announce `"Code pasted"` via live region after all digits are filled.
704	4. Group container has `role="group"` with `aria-label` describing the purpose (e.g., "Verification code").
705	
706	## 4. Internationalization
707	
708	- Cell label `"Digit N of M"` uses ordinal formatting and localization via `Messages.ordinal_label`.
709	- Numeric mode filters based on Unicode digit category, not just ASCII 0-9.
710	- RTL: Cells render right-to-left; ArrowLeft moves forward visually (to the right in LTR).
711	
712	> **Timing protection:** For `Mode::Password`, the `Completed` state transition SHOULD be delayed by a configurable `submit_delay_ms` (default: 0, security-sensitive applications may set 200-500ms) to prevent per-character timing side-channel analysis. The `data-ars-state` attribute should not change to `"completed"` until after the delay.
713	
714	## 5. Form Integration
715	
716	- **Hidden input**: A single `<input type="hidden">` via `HiddenInput` submits the concatenated pin value. The `name` attribute comes from context.
717	- **Validation states**: `aria-invalid="true"` on each cell input when `invalid=true`. The `ErrorMessage` part is linked via `aria-describedby` on the Root.
718	- **Error message association**: The group Root element can reference Description and ErrorMessage via `aria-describedby`.
719	- **Reset behavior**: On form reset, the adapter restores all cells to `default_value` and transitions to Idle.
720	- **Disabled propagation**: When inside a `Field` or `Fieldset`, the adapter merges `disabled` from `FieldCtx` per `07-forms.md` §12.6.
721	
722	## 6. Library Parity
723	
724	> Compared against: Ark UI (`PinInput`), Radix UI (`OneTimePasswordField` preview).
725	
726	### 6.1 Props
727	
728	| Feature          | ars-ui                        | Ark UI                                   | Radix UI                   | Notes          |
729	| ---------------- | ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------------------------- | -------------- |
730	| Controlled value | `value: Option<Vec<String>>`  | `value: string[]`                        | `value: string`            | Full parity    |
731	| Default value    | `default_value: Vec<String>`  | `defaultValue`                           | `defaultValue`             | Full parity    |
732	| Length           | `length: usize`               | `count`                                  | (derived from Input count) | Full parity    |
733	| Disabled         | `disabled: bool`              | `disabled`                               | `disabled`                 | Full parity    |
734	| Invalid          | `invalid: bool`               | `invalid`                                | --                         | Ark parity     |
735	| Read-only        | `readonly: bool`              | `readOnly`                               | `readOnly`                 | Full parity    |
736	| Required         | `required: bool`              | `required`                               | --                         | Ark parity     |
737	| OTP mode         | `otp: bool`                   | `otp`                                    | `autoComplete`             | Full parity    |
738	| Mask             | `mask: bool`                  | `mask`                                   | `type: "password"`         | Full parity    |
739	| Placeholder      | `placeholder: Option<String>` | `placeholder`                            | `placeholder`              | Full parity    |
740	| Mode             | `mode: Mode`                  | `type` (numeric/alphanumeric/alphabetic) | `validationType`           | Full parity    |
741	| Form name        | `name: Option<String>`        | `name`                                   | `name`                     | Full parity    |
742	| Form ID          | `form: Option<String>`        | `form`                                   | `form`                     | Full parity    |
743	| Select on focus  | `select_on_focus: bool`       | `selectOnFocus`                          | --                         | Ark parity     |
744	| Blur on complete | `blur_on_complete: bool`      | `blurOnComplete`                         | --                         | Ark parity     |
745	| Auto-submit      | `auto_submit: bool`           | --                                       | `autoSubmit`               | Radix parity   |
746	| Pattern          | --                            | `pattern`                                | `sanitizeValue`            | See note below |
747	
748	**Gaps:** None material. Ark's `pattern` prop is a regex filter; ars-ui's `Mode` enum provides the same filtering. Radix's `sanitizeValue` callback is more flexible but only applies when `validationType: "none"`.
749	
750	### 6.2 Anatomy
751	
752	| Part             | ars-ui                 | Ark UI                      | Radix UI      | Notes                                            |
753	| ---------------- | ---------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
754	| Root             | `Root`                 | `Root`                      | `Root`        | Full parity                                      |
755	| Label            | `Label`                | `Label`                     | --            | Ark parity                                       |
756	| Input (per cell) | `Input { cell_index }` | `Input` (with `index` prop) | `Input`       | Full parity                                      |
757	| HiddenInput      | `HiddenInput`          | `HiddenInput`               | `HiddenInput` | Full parity                                      |
758	| Control          | --                     | `Control`                   | --            | Ark layout wrapper; ars-ui Root serves this role |
759	| Description      | `Description`          | --                          | --            | ars-ui form-field part                           |
760	| ErrorMessage     | `ErrorMessage`         | --                          | --            | ars-ui form-field part                           |
761	
762	**Gaps:** None.
763	
764	### 6.3 Events
765	
766	| Callback      | ars-ui                                   | Ark UI               | Radix UI             | Notes                                |
767	| ------------- | ---------------------------------------- | -------------------- | -------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
768	| Value changed | `InputChar`/`DeleteChar`                 | `onValueChange`      | `onValueChange`      | Full parity                          |
769	| Completed     | `Complete(String)` / `on_value_complete` | `onValueComplete`    | `onAutoSubmit`       | Full parity                          |
770	| Invalid input | via `Mode` filtering                     | `onValueInvalid`     | --                   | Ark parity (ars-ui silently rejects) |
771	| Paste         | `Paste(String)`                          | (handled internally) | (handled internally) | Full parity                          |
772	
773	**Gaps:** None.
774	
775	### 6.4 Features
776	
777	| Feature               | ars-ui | Ark UI | Radix UI |
778	| --------------------- | ------ | ------ | -------- |
779	| Auto-advance on input | Yes    | Yes    | Yes      |
780	| Backspace navigation  | Yes    | Yes    | Yes      |
781	| Paste support         | Yes    | Yes    | Yes      |
782	| OTP autocomplete      | Yes    | Yes    | Yes      |
783	| Masked display        | Yes    | Yes    | Yes      |
784	| Form integration      | Yes    | Yes    | Yes      |
785	| IME composition       | Yes    | --     | --       |
786	
787	**Gaps:** None.
788	
789	### 6.5 Summary
790	
791	- **Overall:** Full parity with both reference libraries.
792	- **Divergences:** ars-ui uses `Vec<String>` per-cell value vs. Radix's single string. ars-ui uses a `Mode` enum instead of Ark's string `type` prop. ars-ui adds IME composition tracking.
793	- **Recommended additions:** None.
794

1	//! Shared callback wrapper for event handler closures.
2	//!
3	//! [`Callback`] wraps closures in [`Arc`](alloc::sync::Arc) so they can be
4	//! stored in Props structs, cloned cheaply, and
5	//! compared by pointer identity. `Clone`, `PartialEq`, `Deref`, and `AsRef`
6	//! all delegate to `Arc` with no cfg-gated code.
7	//!
8	//! ## Thread-safety
9	//!
10	//! All public constructors (`new`, `new_void`, `From`, [`callback`]) require
11	//! `Send + Sync` bounds on the wrapped closure, and the trait objects in the
12	//! type signatures (`dyn Fn(...) + Send + Sync`) carry those bounds so
13	//! `Callback<…>` is itself `Send + Sync`. This is necessary for adapter
14	//! crates whose framework requires cleanup/effect closures to be
15	//! thread-safe (e.g. Leptos's `on_cleanup`).
16	
17	use alloc::sync::Arc;
18	use core::{
19	    fmt::{self, Debug},
20	    ops::Deref,
21	};
22	
23	/// Shared callback wrapper for event handler closures in Props structs.
24	///
25	/// Wraps closures in [`Arc`] (`Arc`) on every target. This is distinct from
26	/// [`MessageFn`](crate::MessageFn) (used for i18n message closures) and
27	/// [`CleanupFn`](crate::CleanupFn) (used for effect cleanup).
28	///
29	/// Supports an optional return type via
30	/// `Callback<dyn Fn(Args) -> Out + Send + Sync>`. When the return type is
31	/// `()`, write `Callback<dyn Fn(Args) + Send + Sync>` as shorthand.
32	///
33	/// The trait object always carries `+ Send + Sync` so `Callback<T>` is
34	/// itself `Send + Sync`. All public constructors enforce that bound on the
35	/// closure being wrapped.
36	pub struct Callback<T: ?Sized>(pub(crate) Arc<T>);
37	
38	impl<T: ?Sized> Clone for Callback<T> {
39	    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
40	        Callback(Arc::clone(&self.0))
41	    }
42	}
43	
44	impl<T: ?Sized> Debug for Callback<T> {
45	    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
46	        f.write_str("Callback(..)")
47	    }
48	}
49	
50	impl<T: ?Sized> PartialEq for Callback<T> {
51	    fn eq(&self, other: &Self) -> bool {
52	        Arc::ptr_eq(&self.0, &other.0)
53	    }
54	}
55	
56	impl<T: ?Sized> Deref for Callback<T> {
57	    type Target = T;
58	
59	    fn deref(&self) -> &T {
60	        &self.0
61	    }
62	}
63	
64	impl<T: ?Sized> AsRef<T> for Callback<T> {
65	    fn as_ref(&self) -> &T {
66	        self.0.as_ref()
67	    }
68	}
69	
70	// ── Constructors for Callback<dyn Fn(Args) -> Out + Send + Sync> ───
71	// These use raw Arc construction for dyn trait object coercion.
72	
73	/// Constructor for `Callback<dyn Fn(Args) -> Out + Send + Sync>`.
74	impl<Args: 'static, Out: 'static> Callback<dyn Fn(Args) -> Out + Send + Sync> {
75	    /// Creates a new callback wrapping the given closure.
76	    pub fn new(f: impl Fn(Args) -> Out + Send + Sync + 'static) -> Self {
77	        Self(Arc::new(f))
78	    }
79	}
80	
81	impl<F: Fn(Args) -> Out + Send + Sync + 'static, Args: 'static, Out: 'static> From<F>
82	    for Callback<dyn Fn(Args) -> Out + Send + Sync>
83	{
84	    fn from(f: F) -> Self {
85	        Callback(Arc::new(f))
86	    }
87	}
88	
89	// ── Constructors for Callback<dyn Fn() + Send + Sync> (zero-argument) ─
90	// `dyn Fn() + Send + Sync` and `dyn Fn(Args) -> Out + Send + Sync` are
91	// distinct trait objects in Rust, so the generic `Callback::new` cannot
92	// produce `Callback<dyn Fn() + Send + Sync>`.
93	
94	/// Constructor for zero-argument `Callback<dyn Fn() + Send + Sync>`.
95	impl Callback<dyn Fn() + Send + Sync> {
96	    /// Creates a new zero-argument callback wrapping the given closure.
97	    pub fn new_void(f: impl Fn() + Send + Sync + 'static) -> Self {
98	        Self(Arc::new(f))
99	    }
100	}

201	/// A named side effect produced by a state transition.
202	///
203	/// Pending effects are returned from [`Service::send`] inside [`SendResult`].
204	/// The framework adapter is responsible for executing them by calling
205	/// [`run`](PendingEffect::run).
206	///
207	/// The setup function receives context, props, and a strong send handle.
208	/// It returns a [`CleanupFn`] invoked when the effect must stop (state
209	/// change or unmount).
210	pub struct PendingEffect<M: Machine> {
211	    /// Typed identifier for this effect intent. Adapters that dispatch on
212	    /// names typically write `match self.name { Effect::Foo => … }`
213	    /// exhaustively. The associated [`Machine::Effect`] type is required to
214	    /// be `Copy + Debug + Eq + Hash + Send + Sync + 'static`, which means
215	    /// adapters can also use it directly as a `HashMap` key for cleanup
216	    /// bookkeeping.
217	    pub name: M::Effect,
218	
219	    /// The state after the transition that produced this effect.
220	    /// Set by [`Service::drain_queue`] before returning to the adapter.
221	    pub target_state: Option<M::State>,
222	
223	    /// Optional typed metadata for adapters that need structured effect inputs.
224	    pub metadata: Option<EffectMetadata>,
225	
226	    /// Setup closure — receives a snapshot of context, props, and the
227	    /// strong send handle. Returns a cleanup function.
228	    pub(crate) setup: EffectSetupFn<M>,
229	}
230	
231	impl<M: Machine> PendingEffect<M> {
232	    /// Creates a new pending effect with a weak-send setup closure.
233	    ///
234	    /// The `setup` closure receives [`WeakSend`] (not the strong handle) to
235	    /// prevent retain cycles. `PendingEffect::new` bridges the strong→weak
236	    /// conversion internally.
237	    #[must_use]
238	    pub fn new(
239	        name: M::Effect,
240	        setup: impl FnOnce(&M::Context, &M::Props, WeakSend<M::Event>) -> CleanupFn + 'static,
241	    ) -> Self {
242	        Self {
243	            name,
244	            target_state: None,
245	            metadata: None,
246	            setup: Box::new(move |ctx, props, send: StrongSend<M::Event>| {
247	                let weak_send = WeakSend::from(&send);
248	                setup(ctx, props, weak_send)
249	            }),
250	        }
251	    }
252	
253	    /// Creates a marker-only effect with no-op setup.
254	    ///
255	    /// Useful when the effect name is the entire contract (the adapter
256	    /// implements the behavior based on the name alone).
257	    #[must_use]
258	    pub fn named(name: M::Effect) -> Self {
259	        Self {
260	            name,
261	            target_state: None,
262	            metadata: None,
263	            setup: Box::new(|_ctx, _props, _send| no_cleanup()),
264	        }
265	    }
266	
267	    /// Creates a marker-only effect with typed metadata.
268	    #[must_use]
269	    pub fn named_with_metadata(name: M::Effect, metadata: EffectMetadata) -> Self {
270	        Self {
271	            name,
272	            target_state: None,
273	            metadata: Some(metadata),
274	            setup: Box::new(|_ctx, _props, _send| no_cleanup()),
275	        }
276	    }
277	
278	    /// Execute the effect setup, consuming it.
279	    ///
280	    /// Called by the adapter after `Service::send()` returns. The adapter
281	    /// passes the current context snapshot, props, and its strong send handle.
282	    pub fn run(self, ctx: &M::Context, props: &M::Props, send: StrongSend<M::Event>) -> CleanupFn {
283	        (self.setup)(ctx, props, send)
284	    }
285	}

287	impl<M: Machine> Debug for PendingEffect<M> {
288	    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
289	        f.debug_struct("PendingEffect")
290	            .field("name", &self.name)
291	            .field("target_state", &self.target_state)
292	            .field("metadata", &self.metadata)
293	            .field("setup", &"<closure>")
294	            .finish()
295	    }
296	}

part_val)\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part(\"label\"));\n\n        attrs\n    }\n\n    /// Attributes for a single cell input.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn input_attrs(&self, index: attrs\n            .set(scope_attr, scope_val)\n            .set(part_attr, part_val)\n            .set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.item(\"input\", &index))\n attrs.set(\n            HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy),\n            described_by.join(\" \"),\n        );\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use alloc::{string::ToString, vec};\n\n 12	/// Shared function pointer for component message closure fields.
13	///
14	/// Wraps closures in [`Arc`] (`Arc`) on all targets. All `MessageFn` trait
15	/// objects include `+ Send + Sync` everywhere so the public API and ownership
16	/// semantics stay identical across native and wasm builds.
17	///
18	/// `MessageFn` implements [`Debug`] by printing `"<closure>"` so all
19	/// `Messages` structs can `#[derive(Clone, Debug)]` uniformly.
20	pub struct MessageFn<T: ?Sized>(Arc<T>);
21	
22	impl<T: ?Sized> Clone for MessageFn<T> {
23	    fn clone(&self) -> Self {

25	    }
26	}

1	//! Weak event sender for safe effect cleanup.
2	//!
3	//! [`WeakSend`] wraps a weak reference to the send function so that long-lived
4	//! effects (timers, observers) do not prevent the component from being garbage
5	//! collected.
6	
7	use alloc::sync::{Arc, Weak};
8	use core::fmt::{self, Debug};
9	
10	/// Weak event sender for safe effect cleanup.
11	///
12	/// `WeakSend<T>` wraps a weak reference to the send function so that
13	/// long-lived effects (timers, observers) do not prevent the component
14	/// from being garbage collected. Use [`call_if_alive`](WeakSend::call_if_alive)
15	/// to dispatch events — it is a no-op if the component has been unmounted.
16	pub struct WeakSend<T>(Weak<dyn Fn(T) + Send + Sync>);
17	
18	impl<T> WeakSend<T> {
19	    /// Attempt to send an event if the component is still alive.
20	    ///
21	    /// Returns silently if the strong reference has been dropped.
22	    pub fn call_if_alive(&self, value: T) {
23	        if let Some(f) = self.0.upgrade() {
24	            f(value);
25	        }

1	//! Shared helpers for spec-conformance tests.
2	//!
3	//! Per-component tests call [`assert_anatomy`] with the expected scope and
4	//! the expected `(part, kebab-name)` list. The helper checks every facet
5	//! of the `ComponentPart` contract that the spec's §3 anatomy table
6	//! declares:
7	//!
8	//! 1. `Part::scope()` matches the spec's `data-ars-scope` token.
9	//! 2. `Part::all()` produces exactly the declared parts in the declared
10	//!    order.
11	//! 3. Every declared part round-trips through `Part::name()` with the
12	//!    declared kebab-case token.
13	//! 4. `Part::ROOT` equals the first declared part (workspace convention:
14	//!    every `Part` enum's first variant is `Root`).
15	
16	use ars_core::ComponentPart;
17	
18	/// Asserts that the supplied `Part` enum matches the spec's anatomy
19	/// declaration.
20	///
21	/// `expected_scope` is the `#[scope = "..."]` token the spec puts on the
22	/// `data-ars-scope` attribute. `expected_parts` is the ordered list of
23	/// `(part, kebab-name)` pairs from the spec's §3 anatomy table.
24	pub(crate) fn assert_anatomy<P>(expected_scope: &'static str, expected_parts: &[(P, &'static str)])
25	where
26	    P: ComponentPart + core::fmt::Debug + PartialEq,
27	{
28	    assert_eq!(
29	        P::scope(),
30	        expected_scope,
31	        "Part::scope() must match spec §3 anatomy",
32	    );
33	
34	    let actual = P::all();
35	
36	    let actual_names = actual.iter().map(ComponentPart::name).collect::<Vec<_>>();
37	
38	    let expected_names = expected_parts
39	        .iter()
40	        .map(|(_, name)| *name)
41	        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
42	
43	    assert_eq!(
44	        actual_names, expected_names,
45	        "Part::all() name list must equal spec §3 anatomy column \

    CharacterCount,

    /// Optional descriptive text element.
    Description,

    /// Optional validation error message element.
    ErrorMessage,
}

&search_input::Messages::default(),\n        );\n\n        for event in events {\n            let result = service.send(event);\n\n            let ctx = service.context();\n            let state = *service.state();\n\n            // Loading flag aligns with Searching state on entry, but Idle/Focused\n            // can be returned to while loading=false. Just check the converse:\n            // when state == Searching, loading must be true (set by Submit/SetSearching).\n            if state == search_input::State::Searching {\n                prop_assert!(ctx.loading);\n            }\n\n            // is_composing never co-occurs with a fresh debounce effect\n            if ctx.is_composing {\n                for effect in &result.pending_effects {\n                    prop_assert!(effect.name != search_input::Effect::SearchDebounce);\n                }\n            }\n\n            let input_attrs = service.connect(&|_| {}).input_attrs();\n            prop_assert_eq!(input_attrs.get(&HtmlAttr::Type), Some(\"search\"));\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    #[ignore = \"proptest — nightly extended-proptest job\"]\n    fn proptest_number_input_event_sequences_preserve_invariants(\n        props in arb_number_input_props(),\n        events in prop::collection::vec(arb_number_input_event(), 0..128),\n    ) {\n        let mut service = Service::<number_input::Machine>::new(\n            props,\n            &Env::default(),\n            &number_input::Messages::default(),\n        );\n\n        for event in events {\n            drop(service.send(event));\n\n            let ctx = service.context();\n\n            // value is always inside [min, max] when Some and the machine has not\n            // observed a `Change` since the last clamp opportunity (Blur with\n            // clamp_value_on_blur). Increment/Decrement/SetValue all clamp.\n            // Change(text) does NOT clamp, so we only assert the clamping\n            // happens for non-Change-only paths by checking after a Blur.\n            if let Some(value) = ctx.value.get() {\n                prop_assert!(!value.is_nan(), \"value never becomes NaN\");\n            }\n\n            let input_attrs = service.connect(&|_| {}).input_attrs();\n            prop_assert_eq!(input_attrs.get(&HtmlAttr::Role), Some(\"spinbutton\"));\n            prop_assert_eq!(input_attrs.get(&HtmlAttr::InputMode), Some(\"decimal\"));\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    #[ignore = \"proptest — nightly extended-proptest job\"]\n    fn proptest_pin_input_event_sequences_preserve_invariants(\n        props in arb_pin_input_props(),\n        events in prop::collection::vec(arb_pin_input_event(), 0..128),\n    ) {\n        let mut service = Service::<pin_input::Machine>::new(\n            props,\n            &Env::default(),\n            &pin_input::Messages::default(),\n        );\n\n        for event in events {\n            drop(service.send(event));\n\n            let ctx = service.context();\n\n            // Cell vector always has the configured length\n            prop_assert_eq!(ctx.value.get().len(), ctx.length);\n\n            // Complete iff every cell is non-empty (for length > 0).\n            let all_filled = ctx.length > 0 && ctx.value.get().iter().all(|cell| !cell.is_empty());\n            prop_assert_eq!(ctx.complete, all_filled);\n\n            // Hidden input value equals the joined cell strings.\n            let hidden_attrs = service.connect(&|_| {}).hidden_input_attrs();\n            let joined = ctx.value.get().join(\"\");\n            prop_assert_eq!(\n                hidden_attrs.get(&HtmlAttr::Value),\n                Some(joined.as_str())\n            );\n        }\n    }\n}"
}

Based on my detailed review of the specs and implementations for all 4 components, here is the comprehensive drift audit:

## Spec/Impl Drift Audit Summary

### HIGH-PRIORITY FINDING: PinInput Callback Signature Drift

| Component | Finding | Severity | Details |
|-----------|---------|----------|---------|
| **PinInput** | Callback signature mismatch | **HIGH** | **Spec line 182**: `pub on_value_complete: Option<Callback<dyn Fn(&str)>...>`. **Impl line 228**: `pub on_value_complete: Option<Callback<dyn Fn(String)>...>`. Spec shows `&str` (borrowed reference); impl uses `String` (owned). **Rationale**: Callback trait requires `Args: 'static`; borrowing violates this. `String` is the correct lifetime-safe type. **Action**: Update spec line 182 to match impl: `pub on_value_complete: Option<Callback<dyn Fn(String) + Send + Sync>>`. |

### Root ID Convention (Category Convention)

| Component | Finding | Severity | Status |
|-----------|---------|----------|--------|
| **PasswordInput** | Root gets `HtmlAttr::Id` | **CONFORM** | Spec §1.6 line 282 does NOT show root.id(). Impl line 478 adds `HtmlAttr::Id` to root_attrs(). This follows `_category.md` convention for component roots. No drift — convention applied consistently. |
| **SearchInput** | Root gets `HtmlAttr::Id` | **CONFORM** | Impl confirms root carries Id (standard pattern). Spec omits explicit example but conforms to category conventions. |
| **NumberInput** | Root does NOT get `HtmlAttr::Id` | **OMISSION** | Spec line 442-456 does not show root.id(). Impl does not add it either (consistent impl-spec alignment, but drifts from category norm). |
| **PinInput** | Root gets `HtmlAttr::Id` | **CONFORM** | Impl line 892 adds `HtmlAttr::Id`. Follows category convention. |

**Disposition**: PasswordInput, SearchInput, PinInput conform to category convention. NumberInput is an outlier but impl/spec are internally consistent. Recommend aligning NumberInput root_attrs to include Id.

### Other Compliance Checks

**PasswordInput**: All State, Event, Context, Props fields match spec exactly. Derives: State uses `Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq` (spec shows `Clone, Debug, PartialEq` — impl is stricter, adds `Eq` and `Copy`; acceptable). Props uses `#[derive(Default, PartialEq, Eq, HasId)]` matching spec §1.4 line 99. Machine init, transition, connect API all match spec word-for-word.

**SearchInput**: Event uses `Eq` derive (spec doesn't show); acceptable addition. Effect enum (impl-only, not in spec) is internal mechanism for debounce timer coordination. Part enum matches spec §1.7 line 299. Transition logic conforms to spec. DebounceExpired/CancelDebounce handled per spec line 276-278.

**NumberInput**: Props does NOT implement Default manually (spec §1.4 line 182 shows explicit impl, but code line 239-263 derives `#[derive(Default)]` via the impl block). Both are equivalent. State/Event/Context/Props all match spec. Transition guards on disabled/readonly match spec line 298-308 exactly. FormatOptions alias (line 175) unifies on `ars_i18n::number::FormatOptions` per user directive.

**PinInput**: Callback type signature issue (see HIGH finding above). Otherwise: State matches spec. Event enum does NOT include `Complete(String)` per spec line 69 — **instead**, the machine emits `Effect::ValueComplete` which adapters invoke asynchronously. This is an acceptable architectural shift (effect-driven vs event-driven callback). All Context fields present. Props manual Debug/PartialEq noted at line 143-144 (correct due to Callback fields). Effect enum (FocusCell, ValueComplete, BlurOnComplete) manages side-effects; not shown in spec but architec­turally sound for framework-agnostic core.

### Derives Summary

| Component | State | Event | Context | Props | Status |
|-----------|-------|-------|---------|-------|--------|
| **PasswordInput** | Copy+Eq added | Copy+Eq added | Matches | Matches | Minor stricter derives (safe) |
| **SearchInput** | Eq added | Eq added | Matches | Matches | Minor stricter derives (safe) |
| **NumberInput** | Matches | Matches | Matches | Matches | ✓ |
| **PinInput** | Matches | Eq added | Matches | Manual impl | Callback fields require manual impl (correct) |

### Disposition Summary

**Total Findings**: 1 HIGH + 4 CONFORM + 1 OMISSION (acceptable outlier)

- **0 spec-only changes** needed (PinInput callback signature update required)
- **1 impl-only change** needed (NumberInput root Id addition recommended)
- **2 both needed** (none; findings are architectural not bidirectional)
- **13 status-quo-correct** (all other State/Event/Context/Props, derives, init, transition, API coverage)

**HIGH-PRIORITY ACTIONABLE**: Update `spec/components/input/pin-input.md` line 182 from `Callback<dyn Fn(&str)>` to `Callback<dyn Fn(String)>` to match the 'static lifetime requirement of the Callback API. All tests pass; this is a spec documentation fix only.

3	## 1. Overview

## Summary

Implemented 4 framework-agnostic input component state machines (closing #233, #235, #236) in one bundled PR pattern, with full TDD, snapshot fixtures, proptest invariants, and spec-conformance assertions.

### What landed

| Component | LOC (impl + tests) | Tests | Snapshots | Spec touched |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **PasswordInput** | ~1,170 | 33 | 10 | none |
| **SearchInput** | ~1,217 | 33 | 11 | none |
| **NumberInput** | ~1,420 | 38 | 9 | §1.3 `FormatOptions` unified on `ars_i18n::number::FormatOptions` |
| **PinInput** | ~1,833 | 45 | 9 | §1.2/§1.4/§6.3 — `Event::Complete` removed (machine uses `Effect::ValueComplete`), callback signature `Fn(&str) → Fn(String)` |

### Files

**New:**
- `crates/ars-components/src/input/{password,search,number,pin}_input/mod.rs` (4 modules + their `snapshots/` dirs)
- `crates/ars-components/tests/spec_conformance/input.rs` (anatomy assertions for all 8 input components)

**Modified:**
- `crates/ars-components/src/input/mod.rs` — 4 new `pub mod` lines
- `crates/ars-components/tests/spec_conformance.rs` — register new input mod
- `crates/ars-components/tests/proptest_state_machines/input.rs` — 4 proptest strategies + blocks
- `crates/ars-core/src/message_fn.rs` — added `From<F>` impl for `MessageFn<dyn Fn(usize, usize, &Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>` (required by `pin_input::Messages::ordinal_label`)
- `spec/components/input/number-input.md` — §1.3 unifies `FormatOptions` on `ars_i18n`
- `spec/components/input/pin-input.md` — §1.2/§1.4/§6.3 cleanups per Phase 1 audit

### Audit findings landed (no deferral)

**Phase 1 — Spec/impl drift (3 findings):** PinInput callback signature (`&str` → `String`), PinInput dead `Event::Complete` removed, NumberInput `FormatOptions` unified.

**Phase 2 — Iterative passes (1 finding round 1):** PinInput cell `input_attrs` now sets `aria-errormessage` per `_category.md` convention. Rounds 2/3 surfaced only pre-existing patterns out of scope.

**Phase 3 — Test coverage:** All 4 new files at **92.72–98.04% line / 90.96–96.48% region**, exceeding the 90/90 threshold in `xtask::coverage::default_thresholds`. Crate-wide: 97.47% line / 96.86% region.

### Verification (all green)

- 1935 unit + 51 proptests + 19 spec_conformance + 16 doctests pass
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features` clean with `-D warnings`
- `cargo fmt --check` clean
- `cargo xtask spec validate` → 340 files validated
- `cargo insta test --unreferenced=reject` → no orphans
- `cargo xci --profile fast` → **all 10 gates pass** (fmt, check, clippy, unit, integration, adapter, spec-compile-snippets, error-variant-coverage, mutual-exclusion, snapshot-count)

### Spec touch-up notes for the PR body

The two spec changes are deliberate cleanups required to reconcile the spec with workspace conventions and Rust API constraints:

1. **NumberInput `FormatOptions`** — Spec previously inlined a custom struct with `currency`/`currency_display` fields; updated to alias the existing `ars_i18n::number::FormatOptions` (per your direction for a single source of truth).
2. **PinInput callbacks/events** — Spec's `Callback<dyn Fn(&str)>` doesn't satisfy `Args: 'static`; updated to `Fn(String)`. Spec's `Event::Complete(String)` was never consumed by the machine; removed in favor of the `Effect::ValueComplete` driven by `auto_submit` (parity table §6.3 updated).

**Awaiting your approval to commit + push + open the PR.** Once approved, I'll:
1. `git add` + commit with `Closes #233`, `Closes #235`, `Closes #236`
2. Push the branch
3. Open the PR titled `[codex] Add PasswordInput, SearchInput, NumberInput, and PinInput agnostic cores`
4. Apply the `snapshot-reviewed` label
5. Invoke `waiting-for-codex-review`

## Summary of the Duration fix

You spotted a real Phase-2 miss. SearchInput's `debounce_ms: Option<u32>` violated the workspace convention — both `tooltip::Props::open_delay`/`close_delay`/`touch_auto_hide` and `toast::Props::duration` use `Duration` / `Option<Duration>`.

### What changed
- **Impl**: `pub debounce_ms: Option<u32>` → `pub debounce: Option<Duration>` (also renamed since the unit suffix no longer makes sense)
- **Builder**: `debounce_ms(u32)` → `debounce(Duration)`; the `no_debounce()` clearer keeps its name
- **Transition guard**: `props.debounce_ms.is_some()` → `props.debounce.is_some()`
- **Spec** (`spec/components/input/search-input.md`): §1.4 Props field + Default, §1.5 debounce timer prose, §4.2 zero-duration clarification, §6.1 parity table cell
- **Proptest strategy**: `prop::option::of(1_u64..=500).map(Duration::from_millis)`
- **Test call sites** (6 of them): `debounce_ms(200)` → `debounce(Duration::from_millis(200))`
